4551038.presentation: ABC Motors Company Limited imports and sells motor vehicles and spare parts in Mauritius. It also distributes light commercial, heavy goods vehicles, trucks, and buses under the Nissan, UD, Datsun, Infiniti, and Eicher brand names, as well as provides after sales services. In addition, the company involved in the panel and paint repairs, body polish, head lamp polish, and valeting. ABC Motors Company Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4537836.presentation: ABCB Holdings Limited, a financial services holding company, provides various banking products and services in Mauritius, Hong Kong, and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers current, corporate current, and premier, junior, and senior savings accounts; term and fixed deposits; debit and credit cards; and home, vehicle, education, life projects, mortgage, term, and Lombard loans. It also provides investment and wealth management; working capital; forex and foreign currency transactions; letter of credit; business banking; and digital banking, including mobile app, internet banking, and e-signature. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4254283.presentation: Absa Bank Botswana Limited provides financial services in Botswana. The company operates through Corporate and Investment Banking; and Retail Business Banking and Other segments. It offers current and savings accounts, fixed term deposits, cheque account deposits, call accounts, and foreign currency accounts; loan solutions, such as personal loan, scheme loan, graduate loan, home loan and multi-residential loan, car loan, and green energy loan, as well as business credit card, business loan, agri-business loan, commercial asset finance, purchase order finance, and enterprise and supply chain development program. The company also provides insurance solutions, including house and contents insurance, personal possession insurance, car insurance, HerShield, retrenchment insurance, life insurance, and Lorako business and agriculture insurance; merchant services comprising e-commerce, point of sale, mPOS, and integrated solutions; cash management consisting of online banking, cash deposit, payments, business and corporate prepaid cards, collections, and liquidity management. In addition, it offers trade finance solutions, which includes trade management online, invoice financing, bonds, guarantees, and indemnities; foreign exchange, currency repo, risk management, and investment services, and market updates; and debit and credit cards. The company was formerly known as Barclays Bank of Botswana Limited and changed its name to Absa Bank Botswana Limited in February 2020. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana. Absa Bank Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Absa Group Limited.

4416626.presentation: Access Bank (Ghana) Plc provides various banking products and services in Ghana and internationally. It operates through four segments: Institutional Banking, Personal and Business Banking, Commercial Banking, and Treasury and Investment Banking. The company offers insurance products; cash-backed, instant business, payday, personal, and w-power loans, as well as mortgage, device and vehicle finance, and maternal health services; money transfer; access savings, corporate, and domiciliary accounts; and bills for collection and letter of credit. It also provides bonds and guarantees; cash management, including payment, credit/debit/prepaid cards, and collections; financing solutions; global trade services; project and structured finance; supply chain finance; trade finance; treasury services, such as treasury bills, fixed deposits, and call deposits; and agency, digital, internet, private, and sustainable banking. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. Access Bank (Ghana) Plc operates as a subsidiary of Access Bank Plc.

4986268.presentation: AECI Mining Explosives PLC manufactures and supplies mining explosives and mining chemicals in Africa, Europe, Southeast Asia, North America, South America, and Australia. It operates in four segments: AECI Mining, AECI Chemicals, AECI Managed Businesses, and AECI Property Services and Corporate. The AECI Mining segment provides a mine-to-mineral solution for the international mining sector, including commercial explosives, initiating systems, blasting services, and surfactants for explosives manufacturers Its AECI Chemicals segment supplies traded, industrial, and specialty chemicals, as well as water treatment chemicals, technology, equipment, and plant and crop protection products and plant nutrients. The AECI Managed Businesses segment engages in agriculture, industrial, manufacturing, road infrastructure, food and beverage, public water, and animal feed businesses, as well as the textile sector. Its AECI Property Services and Corporate segment is involved in property leasing and management in the office, industrial, and retail sectors. It serves the mining sector, water treatment market, plant and animal health industry, food and beverage, and the manufacturing and general industrial sectors. The company was formerly known as AEL Zambia Plc and changed its name to AECI Mining Explosives PLC in August 2021. AECI Mining Explosives PLC was incorporated in 1924 and is based in Johannesburg, South Africa.

13451580.activite: Independent Power Producers and Energy Traders
13451580.presentation: Africa Clean Energy Solutions Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides clean energy solutions in Mauritius and internationally. It produces energy using solar, biogas photovoltaic, and biomass, as well as operates various projects, including grid-tied, hybrid, and off-grid systems for corporate and private clients. It offers solar rooftop and battery storage solutions for commercial enterprises; engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions; and financing services. The company serves commercial enterprises, industrial complexes, office buildings, educational institutions, agricultural lands, and mining operations. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Ebene, Mauritius.

4995250.nom: Africa Global Logistics (AGL) Côte d'Ivoire S.A.
4995250.presentation: Africa Global Logistics (AGL) Côte d'Ivoire S.A. provides transport and logistics solutions in Africa and internationally. It offers port handling; rail, sea, air, and express transport; warehousing; supply chain management; and shipyard services. The company was formerly known as Bolloré Transport & Logistics Côte d'Ivoire (BTL CI) S.A. and changed its name to Africa Global Logistics (AGL) Côte d'Ivoire S.A. in April 2023. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Africa Global Logistics (AGL) Côte d'Ivoire S.A. is a subsidiary of Africa Global Logistics (France).

7161105.presentation: Agra Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the agricultural retail and wholesale business in Namibia. It operates in four segments: Retail and Wholesale, Auctions, Rental, and ProVision. The company offers hardware, paint and accessories, building materials, tools, and electrical products; convenience stores, which include fast food, bread, coffee, groceries, beverages, snacks, ice, and braai essentials, such as charcoal and wood; water equipment, pesticides and fertilizers, animal health products, hardware and gardening supplies, and equestrian accessories; veterinary pharmaceuticals, veterinary medicines, and over-the-counter products; hunting, camping, fishing, and safari equipment; firearms, ammunition, and telescopes, as well as expert advice; sports rifles; and agricultural supplies, animal feed, veterinary supplies, fencing materials, seed, fertilizer, tools, hardware, farming infrastructure, personal protective equipment, building materials, home improvement items, automotive products, and everyday household essentials. It also provides mentorship programs, training courses, consultancy services, and technological advice for business development, farming, and production management; and education and training with e-learning platform. In addition, the company organizes and facilitates auction and liaison services of livestock and agricultural products; measures the performance of various commercial and residential rental properties; and markets and auctions movable goods, and agricultural, industrial, commercial, and residential properties online, as well as invests in, upgrades, and renovates residential and commercial properties. Further it operates Auas shopping mall with retail outlets offering fast-moving consumables, outdoor products, restaurants, personal grooming services, medical practitioners, pharmacy, and DIY and farming essentials; and operates fuel stations. Agra Limited was founded in 1946 and is based in Windhoek, Namibia.

4401256.presentation: Agricultural Development Bank Plc provides corporate, investment, and retail banking products and services in Ghana. It offers corporate banking services comprising business bank accounts; business overdraft, business invoice factoring, import and export documentary credit, import and export bills, trade and supply chain protection, foreign exchange risk management, foreign exchange, foreign currency account, guarantees, and export invoice finance services; payments and cash management services; funding solutions; and asset finance services. The company also provides retail banking services, including current, savings deposit, salary, student save, and Mmofra accounts, as well as electronic banking services. In addition, it offers risk management services, such as market/financial and operational risks, and compliance units; treasury management services, including foreign exchange, fixed deposit, call account, rediscounting of bill, primary dealer and secondary market activities, repurchase contract, and custody services; agribusiness products and services; executive banking; and commercial/SME short and medium term loans, inventory financing facilities, working capital lending, contractor financing, import and export financing, and bridge and LPO financing. Agricultural Development Bank Plc was founded in 1964 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4985251.nom: Air Liquide Côte d'Ivoire Société Anonyme
4985251.presentation: Air Liquide Côte d'Ivoire Société Anonyme develops and supplies industrial gases in Western Africa. The company provides its products to various sectors, such as oil and gas, mining and quarrying, food and beverage, metal fabrication and construction, healthcare, laboratories, and research centres. Air Liquide Côte d'Ivoire Société Anonyme was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast.

19667844.presentation: Airtel Malawi Plc offers mobile telecommunication services in Malawi. The company provides GSM mobile cellular telephone, leased line, voice telephony, messaging, data, international and national long-distance telecommunications, and value-added services, as well as fixed broadband internet, roaming, and mobile money services. It also sells simcards, handsets, accessories, and other equipment. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Lilongwe, Malawi. Airtel Malawi Plc is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Malawi Holdings B.V.

4999945.presentation: Airtel Networks Zambia Plc provides cellular radio telecommunication services for businesses, communities, and individuals in Zambia. The company offers prepaid products, such as voice, internet, and value-added services; international calling and roaming products; home broadband for households, entrepreneurs, and small businesses; MyAirtel App, a self-service mobile application; and digital payments, self-service account management, and simplified onboarding for new services. It also provides 4G devices, including MiFis, phones, and dongles; fixed voice, bulk SMS, closed user group, postpaid services, hybrid services, and toll-free services; data center services, international leased circuits, co-location services, and VPN; and audio and video conferencing services, and virtual PABX. The company was formerly known as Celtel Zambia Plc and changed its name to Airtel Networks Zambia Plc in April 2013. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia. Airtel Networks Zambia Plc operates as a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Zambia Holdings B.V.

13981277.presentation: Almarys Limited operates agricultural land. The company operates through Agribusiness, Real Estate, Hospitality & Travel, Logistics, Finance, Commerce & Manufacturing, Technology & Energy, Investments & Managements Office segments. It also serves sugar cane, food crops, livestock, agri; homes, workplaces, malls, territories; hotels, leisure, aviation and travel; cross-border logistics, landside logistics, packing and shipping; credit, fiduciary, leasing; automotive, trade and manufacturing; and technology, energy, innovation sectors. The company was formerly known as ENL Limited and changed its name to Almarys Limited in September 2025. Almarys Limited was founded in 1821 and is based in Moka, Mauritius. Almarys Limited operates as a subsidiary of La Sablonnière Holding Limited.

4347936.presentation: Alphamin Resources Corp., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells tin concentrates. Its principal project is the Bisie tin mine located in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The company was formerly known as La Plata Gold Corporation and changed its name to Alphamin Resources Corp. in October 2008. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Grand Baie, Mauritius. Alphamin Resources Corp. is a subsidiary of Alpha Mining Ltd.

4910621.presentation: Alteo Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in cultivating, harvesting, and milling sugarcane in Mauritius. It operates in three segments: Sugar, Energy, and Property. The Sugar segment is involved in the planting and harvesting of sugar cane and other food crops, sugar cane milling, and sugar refining. Its Energy segment operates bagasse and coal power plants to supply steam and electricity. The Property segment engages in the promotion, marketing, and sale of villas, apartments, and serviced land, as well as the operates18-hole championship golf course located in Anahita. The company also provides real estate development, hospitality and leisure, vocational and professional training, and poultry farming services. Alteo Limited was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Saint Pierre, Mauritius.

6474823.presentation: Arindo Holdings (Mauritius) Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Arindo Holdings (Mauritius) Limited operates as a subsidiary of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk.

4911161.presentation: Associated Commercial Company Limited engages in the import and distribution of tyres and motor vehicle spare parts in Mauritius. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4980970.presentation: Attitude Property Ltd engages in the rental of investment properties in Mauritius. The company sublet the leasehold land to the three hotels, including Ravenala Attitude, Recif Attitude, and Tropical Attitude. The company was formerly known as Neymar Ltd. and changed its name to Attitude Property Ltd in May 2014. Attitude Property Ltd was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4988678.presentation: Automatic Systems Ltd operates a totalisator system (Tote) of betting on horse races in Mauritius. It operates through three segments: Totalisator, Fixed Odds, and All Other Segments. The company organizes betting on horse races under the Supertote brand name; and betting on foreign football matches under the Superscore brand name. It also operates supertote.mu, a website for Tote betting and featuring live racing, training, and race videos, as well as comprehensive horse forms; and superscore.mu, a website that covers football betting. The company offers its betting services through punters on course, off course, and telephone channels. Automatic Systems Ltd was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4399150.presentation: Bank of Africa - Benin SA provides various banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Benin. It offers checking accounts; debit and credit cards; savings accounts and investment product, including time deposit. The company also provides loans, such as real estate, school, consumer, equipment, vehicle, travel, group, personal, vitamin, and advance loans, as well as over drafting services. In addition, it offers insurance products; and money transfer services, as well as provides mobile banking services. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cotonou, Benin. Bank of Africa - Benin SA operates as a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

4437697.presentation: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso provides commercial bank services for retail, corporate, and financial markets in Burkina Faso. The company offers savings, checking, and foreign currency accounts; cards; packs; term deposits and cash receipts; digital banking; house, equipment, group, personal, consumer, vitamin, motorcycle, and salary advance loans; travel, auto, educ, borrowing, inventory, and key man insurance products; and money transfer services. It also provides funding; campaign credit; cash facilities and overdrafts; bridge loans; spot credit; discounts; advance on stock, goods, and DAT; cautions; avals; advance payment; advance on stock; documentary operations and submissions; foreign currency endorsements; checks or bills in foreign currency; documentary credits; letter of guarantee; trade express and currency transfers; and investment financing and BOA leasing. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

4416283.presentation: Bank of Africa Mali SA provides various banking products and services to individuals, business customers, and SMEs in Mali. It offers checking, current, foreign currency, and savings accounts, and term deposits; house, consumer, personal, and various other loans; cards; financing of activities; investment products; insurance products; and money transfer and digital banking services. The company also provides foreign currency endorsements, letter of credit, transfers, and documentary discounts and credits. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Bamako, Mali. Bank of Africa Mali SA is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

4565824.presentation: Bank of Africa Niger provides banking services for individuals and companies primarily in Niger. The company’s products and services include accounts, savings plans, term deposits, and operating and documentary credit services; letters of credit; medium and long term loans; insurance; loans, cards, and money transfers; and online, phone, and SMS banking services. It operates in retail, corporate, and financial markets. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Niamey, Niger. Bank of Africa Niger is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

4437734.presentation: Bank Of Africa Senegal provides various banking products and services in Senegal. The company offers current, savings, investment, and currency accounts; term deposits; education, marketplace, home, car, consumer, equipment, and overdraft loans; cards; and money transfer, insurance, and digital banking services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Dakar, Senegal. Bank Of Africa Senegal is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

4576001.presentation: Bayport Management Ltd, through its subsidiaries, provides retail financial services in Botswana, Ghana, Mozambique, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, Colombia, and Mexico. The company offers personal loan products, including retail and payroll loans to informal traders and micro enterprises, as well as car title-backed loans. It also provides savings and fixed deposit; and transactional accounts. In addition, the company offers insurance products, such as education protection plans, hospital cover, and funeral cover; and credit insurance. Bayport Management Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Ebene, Mauritius.

4980850.presentation: Beau Vallon Hospitality Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates hotels in Mauritius, France, the Republic of South Africa, Reunion Island, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, and internationally. The company operates the Preskil Island Resort, a family resort at Pointe Jérôme, Mahebourg; Solana Beach Mauritius, an adults-only resort located in Belle Mare; and Astroea Beach, a boutique hotel at Pointe D’Esny, as well as beach hotels under the Beau Vallon Hospitality brand. It also provides training and management services. The company was formerly known as Southern Cross Tourist Company Limited and changed its name to Beau Vallon Hospitality Ltd in February 2024. Beau Vallon Hospitality Ltd was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Saint Hubert, Mauritius.

4912606.presentation: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC engages in the production of palm oil primarily in Ghana. It grows oil palm; and processes palm fruits to produce palm oil and palm kernel oil. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Takoradi, Ghana. Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC is a subsidiary of Wilmar Africa Limited.

4993221.presentation: Bernabe Cote D'ivoire SA engages in the trading and distribution of hardware products, tools, industrial equipment, metallurgical products, and construction materials. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Bernabe Cote D'ivoire SA is a subsidiary of Yeshi Group.

4864257.presentation: BlueLife Limited engages in the land promotion, property development, and hotel and leisure businesses in Mauritius. It operates through three segments: Property, Hospitality & Leisure, and Services. The company develops and sells offices, rental units, hotel, land for mixed-used developments, and golf course under the name Azuri Ocean & Golf Village; commercial buildings; and owns and operates hotels under the name of Radisson Blu Azuri Resort & Spa. It also provides facilities management, cleaning, housekeeping, syndicate management, rental, and resale service; property investment services; management and consultancy services; and real estate activities, as well as operates other sports facilities. BlueLife Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4654147.presentation: BMH Ltd invests in the hospitality, financial services, and commerce sectors in Mauritius and Maldives. BMH Ltd was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Centre De Flacq, Mauritius.

4022858.presentation: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in providing financial solutions in Botswana. It operates through Life Business and Asset Management segments. Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana. Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sanlam Allianz Africa (Pty) Ltd.

4999239.presentation: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation Limited provides telecommunications services in Botswana. The company offers fixed voice and data services; mobile services; directory services; cloud and digital services; satellite internet broadband solutions; data services; virtual private networks; and customer premises equipment. It also provides mobile financial services; voice and collaboration services, such as fixed line, toll-free directory, MiVoice, MiCollab, MiContact centre business, smart offices, conferences, telephone management, and call recordings; office, home, and mobile internet services; site connectivity; and digital services, including data centers, colocation, cloud, and Microsoft 365 solutions, as well as mobile phones. In addition, it offers internet devices that includes LTE routers and Mifi; fixed landlines and tariffs; and BTC mobile products and services. Further, the company provides Smega, a mobile money wallet stored on mobile phones which enables customers to make financial transactions. It serves large, medium, and small enterprises; government entities; and individual customers, as well as other licensed service providers. Botswana Telecommunications Corporation Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

4914867.presentation: British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc engages in the manufacturing, sales, and distribution of cigarettes and nicotine products in Zambia. The company offers vapour, tobacco heated products, modern and traditional oral, and combustible tobacco products. It sells its products under the Vuse, Glo, Velo, Grizzly, Dunhill, Kent, Lucky Strike, Pall Mall, Rothmans, Camel, Natural American Spirit, Newport, Vogue, Viceroy, Kool, Peter Stuyvesant, Craven A, and State Express 555 brand names. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia. British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc operates as a subsidiary of British American Tobacco International Holdings (UK) Limited.

5241619.presentation: CA Sales Holdings Limited engages in the fast-moving consumer good business in Botswana, Eswatini, Namibia, South Africa, Lesotho, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Mauritius, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. The company provides warehousing, in-store execution, transport and logistics, sales, merchandising, technology, data services, shopper marketing, brand strategy development, point-of-sale, and retail training services, as well as select debtor services. It offers consumer products, including food, home care, personal care, consumer durables, snack and confectionery, paper products, beverages, pet care, alcoholic beverages, frozen foods, and tobacco products and accessories. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Centurion, South Africa.

4388378.presentation: CalBank PLC provides various banking products and services in Ghana. It offers premium, current, student, home invest, kids saving, and flexisave accounts. The company also provides personal, auto, government employee, mortgage, and salary advance, working capital, and term loan; and structured trade and commodity, syndicated lending, asset, and international trade finance services. In addition, it offers save and invest, bancassurance, agent banking, cash and card management, and digital banking services; transaction banking, corporate and project financing services; women’s banking; and payment solutions. CalBank PLC was founded in 1990 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4395663.presentation: Capricorn Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the banking, microlending, and related businesses in Namibia, Botswana, and Zambia. The company’s products and services include savings, investment, loan, credit, and deposits. It also offers advisory, asset management, foreign exchange related finance, and insurance products. In addition, the company provides lending, wealth management, asset management, and trust management services, as well as offers property development and evaluation services, and facilitates payments. Further, it provides recapitalisations, mergers, acquisitions, due diligence, and restructuring services. The company was formerly known as Capricorn Investment Group Limited and changed its name to Capricorn Group Limited in May 2020. Capricorn Group Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Windhoek, Namibia.

4982053.presentation: Chilanga Cement PLC engages in the manufacture and sale of cement products in Zambia. The company offers Mphamvu 32.5N, a general-purpose bagged cement for building and construction projects; SupaSet 42.5R, a rapid-setting cement for concrete blocks, bridge culverts, and concrete pipes; Powerplus 42.5N, an ordinary Portland cement for heavy construction projects, including bridges, railways, stadiums, and airports; Powerbuild 42.5N for mass concrete applications in the foundations of large buildings; Supablock 42.5N, used in bricks and blockmaking; and Pawalime quicklime, acts as a flux for removing impurities, such as phosphorus, sulphur, silica, and manganese from molten stee. It also exports its products to Zimbabwe, Malawi, Zambia, and Burundi. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Zambia Plc and changed its name to Chilanga Cement PLC. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia. Chilanga Cement PLC is a subsidiary of Huaxin (Hainan) Investment Co., Ltd.

4981102.presentation: Chobe Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in owning and operating ecotourism lodges and camps on leased lands in Northern Botswana and the Caprivi Strip in Namibia. It operates through Camp, Lodge and Safari Operations; Transfers and Touring; Aircraft Maintenance Operations; and Other segments. The company operates full-service accommodation, lodges and camps under the Desert & Delta Safaris, Chobe Game Lodge, Ker & Downey Botswana, and Zambia brands. It also provides air, road, and water transfer services; game viewing services; farming; property rental; bed nights in camps, lodges, and hotel rooms; suite of aircraft maintenance services; farming, property rental, and other miscellaneous operations. In addition, the company offers tour and safari services; management services; reservation services; guided tours; and air charter services. Further, it leases farmland and equipment; and exports goods for lodges. Chobe Holdings Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana.

4912246.presentation: Choppies Enterprises Limited operates a chain of supermarkets in Botswana, Zambia, and Namibia. The company operates through Botswana; Namibia; Zambia; Liquorama; and Rest of Choppies segments. It offers fast-moving consumer goods; engages in retail and wholesale of liquor; and milling and manufacturing of tissue and bottled water, as well as hardware retail business. The company’s stores offer fresh, frozen, canned, dry foods, snacks, ethnic specialties, health and beauty care, household, as well as laundry and tobacco products, and other general merchandise. It also provides value-added financial services. The company operates all its stores under the Choppies brand name. Choppies Enterprises Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana.

4440411.presentation: CIEL Limited, an investment holding company, operates in multiple business sectors in Mauritius, Madagascar, Asia, South Africa, and internationally. It operates in seven segments: Textile, Agro, Property, Hotels and Resorts, Financial, Healthcare, and CIEL. The Textile segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of knitwear, woven, and fine knit products. Its Agro segment produces and sells sugar. The Property segment develops land and properties. Its Hotels and Resorts segment engages in the ownership and management of a portfolio of hotels. This segment also owns and manages properties in Mauritius, a private island, a golf course, and tour operators. The Financial Services segment provides banking, portfolio management, and fiduciary products. Its Healthcare segment operates healthcare facilities comprising hospitals, primary and secondary care clinics, laboratories, c-lab collection centers. CIEL Limited was formerly known as Deep River Investment Limited and changed its name to CIEL Limited in January 2014. The company was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Ebene, Mauritius.

4772730.presentation: CIM Financial Services Ltd, a non-banking financial institution, provides financial solutions to individual consumers, SMEs, and corporates in Mauritius and internationally. The company operates in Finance and Investments segments. The Finance segment provides consumer credit, leasing, card acquiring and issuing, insurance, and factoring services. The Investments segment offers strategy monitoring, performance monitoring, and statutory reporting services; and supports SBUs. It also engages in insurance agency business; offers secretarial and management services; and acts as corporate trustee. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. CIM Financial Services Ltd is a subsidiary of Cim Holdings Ltd..

4970118.presentation: Clydestone Ghana PLC operates as an information and communications technology company in Ghana, Nigeria, and Kenya. It develops solutions in the areas of financial document processing, remittance processing, and transaction switching. The company offers G- Switch, an electronic payment platform that provides transaction switching, third party processing, and EFT hosting services to banks, independent service organizations, and micro finance institutions; G-Secure, a platform to support the card association's 3D-Secure authentication programmes; UnionPay Processor for payment convenience and issuance of UnionPay standard cards; Automated Cheque Clearing, a cheque clearing suite and a web based solution, which brings the intelligent automation benefits of high resolution imaging to financial services institutions; automatic teller machines (ATM) and cash processing; multi-vendor ATM software; and multi-factor authentication solutions. Clydestone Ghana PLC was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4916864.presentation: Cocoa Processing Company Limited processes cocoa beans to semi-finished products in Ghana. The company offers semi-finished products, such as cocoa liquor, butter, chocolate coated Peanut, chocolate powder, choco delight, choco bake, and cocoa powder under Portem brand name. It also manufactures and markets chocolate bars under the Kingsbite, Oranco, Akuafo, Coffee Choc, Portem Nut, Portem Pride, Tetteh Quarshie, and Aspire brand names; chocolate dragee under Pebbles brand; chocolate spread under Choco Delight name; drinking chocolate under Royale Natural Cocoa Powder, Alltime, and Vitaco name; and chocolate couvertures under Choco Bake brand name. Cocoa Processing Company Limited was founded in 1965 and is based in Tema, Ghana.

4977945.presentation: Compagnie Immobilière Limitée operates as a real estate investment company in Mauritius. It is involved in the development, management, and rental of properties. The company’s flagship property includes Les Arcades Currimjee located in the corner of Royal Road and Sir Winston Churchill Street in Curepipe. Compagnie Immobilière Limitée was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4980736.presentation: Constance Hotels Services Limited, an investment holding company, operates and manages hotels and resorts in Mauritius, Madagascar, the Seychelles, and the Maldives. It owns hotels and championship golf courses. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Centre De Flacq, Mauritius. Constance Hotels Services Limited is a subsidiary of Hotelest Limited.

4911092.presentation: Constance La Gaiete Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sugarcane cultivation business. It operates through Agriculture Products and Related Activities, Livestock and Aquaculture, Property, and Other Activities segments. The company is involved in the sugar and related activities and agricultural diversification business; sale of poultry, venison, and oyster; and development and sale of building projects, as well as operates sewage treatment plant and food and beverage outlet. It also engages in the production of food crops and fruits, as well as broiler farming, cattle rearing, and deer farming activities. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is based in Centre De Flacq, Mauritius.

4819184.presentation: Coris Bank International SA provides banking products and services to individual, business, and NGO/association customers in Burkina Faso. It offers checking, savings, term deposit, money, and business accounts; guarantees; bank cards; SMS banking services; tax deposits; cash, real estate, operating, and investment credits; cardless money services; and foreign exchange transactions, transfers, and e-statement services, as well as operates E-CORIS services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. Coris Bank International SA operates as a subsidiary of Coris Holding SA.

4403513.presentation: CRDB Bank Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate and retail banking services for individuals, small and medium enterprises (SME), corporates, and high net worth individuals in the United Republic of Tanzania, the Republic of Burundi, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The company operates through Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Treasury segments. It provides current, malkia, savings, junior jumbo, call, fixed deposit, salary, bidii, Hodari, teen, niamoja, pension, and scholar accounts; personal and salary advance loans; SME, MSE, malkia, and komboa loans; debit cards; short- and long-term loans; and trade finance, overdraft facilities, contract financing for construction, asset-based financing, utility services, general business, and agricultural based project financing. The company also offers foreign exchange, financial, custodial, and registrar-ship services; government securities; securities brokerage services; internet and mobile banking services; and motor, credit life assurance, personal accident, domestic package, fire, group life, fidelity guarantee, goods in transit, marine, money, and all risk insurance products. It operates through a network of multiple branches, automated teller machines, point of sales terminals, digital channels, and agents. CRDB Bank Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4980903.presentation: Cresta Marakanelo Limited operates hotels and related services in Botswana. It operates through Cresta Urban Oasis, Cresta Urban Heartbeat, Cresta African Roots, and Cresta African fingerprint segments. The Cresta Urban Oasis segment operates hotels, including Cresta Lodge Gaborone and Cresta Marang Gardens, which provide meeting and conference rooms, wireless internet access, and restaurant services primarily to business travelers. The Cresta Urban Heartbeat segment operates hotels under the Cresta President Hotel and Cresta Thapama Hotel brands, which offer rooms and restaurants primarily to business meals. The Cresta African Roots segment operates hotels under the Cresta Riley’s Hotel, Cresta Bosele Hotel, Cresta Jwaneng Hotel, Cresta Mahalpye Hotel, and Cresta Botsalo Hotel brands. The Cresta African Fingerprint segment operates two hotels under the Mowana Resort and Spa, and Cresta Maun Resort brands, which provide rooms, restaurants, safaris, and other activities. Cresta Marakanelo Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

4998288.nom: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc
4998288.presentation: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc operates as a securities exchange in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers a platform that assists companies in raising capital through the issuance of equities and debt securities; and securities market to investors who intend to invest in the listed companies. Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4574328.presentation: DCB Commercial Bank Plc provides various banking products and services in Tanzania. The company operates through Business Banking, Personal Banking, Microfinance, Treasury, and Other segments. It offers current, savings, student, joint, young saver, solidarity group, bamba, call, and royal and corporate customer accounts, as well as time and fixed deposits. The company also provides loans, such as salaried, housing microfinance, digital salary advance, and school fees; loans for fixed deposits; loans to micro and small business sector and savings and co-operative credit societies; solidarity group lending; equipment/investment loans; and medium entrepreneur, micro-individual, small entrepreneur, and macro/corporate loans. In addition, the company offers trade finance, asset financing, and insurance services; foreign currency services; money market services, including treasury bills, bond investments, fixed income trading, and other products; and internet and mobile banking, and electronic money transfer services. It offers its products and services to individuals, small and medium sized businesses, and corporate clients. The company operates through a network of branches and ATMs. DCB Commercial Bank Plc was formerly known as Dar es Salaam Community Bank Plc and changed its name to DCB Commercial Bank Plc in February 2012. DCB Commercial Bank Plc was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

10488188.presentation: Digicut Production & Advertising PLC provides advertising agency and public relations consultancy services in Ghana. It offers event planning and consultancy services, event management, advertising, marketing, public relations, PVC ID cards production, digital imaging on SAV, and flexy production and general printing. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4547956.presentation: Ecobank Côte d'Ivoire provides consumer, group, corporate and investment, and commercial banking services. Its products include, cards; loans; payment and transfers; investment solutions; e-products; term deposits; and microfinance. The bank was founded in 1989 and is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Ecobank Côte d'Ivoire operates as a subsidiary of Ecobank Transnational Incorporated.

4403778.presentation: Ecobank Ghana PLC provides retail banking, corporate and investment banking, and other financial services in Ghana and internationally. It operates through Consumer Banking, Commercial Banking, Corporate Banking, and Treasury segments. The company offers deposit, current, savings, and electronic accounts; personal loans, advance facility, mortgage loan, travel loan, salary advance, and cash backed loan; debit and credit cards; payment, collection, and structured trade solutions under the Ecobank OMNIPlus, Ecobank OMNILite, Bank Collect, and SWIFT brands. It also provides working capital loans, asset financing, project finance, and borrowing base structures; fixed income, currencies, and commodities solutions; balance sheet management for oversight and analytical rigor; and custody services, including safekeeping, settlement and administrative services for securities, cash and other financial assets. In addition, the company offers financial advisory, debt capital markets, loan syndications, mergers and acquisitions, and principal financing; payments, bancassurance, and wealth management products; overdrafts, funds transfers, standing orders, and ATM card services. It serves individual clients, corporations, and financial organizations. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. Ecobank Ghana PLC operates as a subsidiary of Ecobank Transnational Incorporated.

4977136.activite: Oil and Gas Refining and Marketing
4977136.presentation: Engen Botswana Limited engages in the petrochemical investments and property operations businesses in Botswana. The company operates through two segments, Petrochemical Activities and Property Letting. It operates service stations; and sells and markets bulk petroleum products, including diesel, gasoline, and kerosene, as well as lubricants and functional fluids. The also company is involved in the selling and distributing fuel; and property letting activities. It serves agriculture, aviation, chemical, fleet, marine, and mining industries. The company is based in Gaborone, Botswana. Engen Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Engen Limited.

4418358.presentation: Enterprise Group PLC, through its subsidiaries, provides insurance services in Ghana, Nigeria, and the Gambia. It operates through seven segments: the Non-Life Insurance Business, Life Assurance Business, Health Insurance, Pension Administration, Real Estate, Funeral Services, and Investments segments. The company offers personal insurance products, including pet, home advantage, third party amplified, compExtra enhanced motor comprehensive policy, motor, home, travel, and personal accident; and corporate insurance products, including assets all risk, employers liability, erection all risk, fidelity guarantee, product liability, electronic equipment, consequential loss or business interruption, professional indemnity, marine, public liability, money, motor, household content, contractors-all-risk, custom bonds, goods-in-transit, burglary, cash in transit, fire and allied perils, group personal accident, and special risk insurance solutions. It also provides enterprise living plus, enterprise executive plus, lady care, family income protection, lifetime needs, and funeral finance plans, as well as educare and AkwantuPa; microinsurance, corporate risk, credit life, and group funeral plans; burial and memorial services, as well as operates properties. In addition, the company offers occupational pension, provident fund, and enterprise personal pension schemes, as well as fund administration services; manages pension funds; develops and manages real estate; and funeral services. Enterprise Group PLC was founded in 1924 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4987887.presentation: Excelsior United Development Companies Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the beverages, financial services, property, and other diversified products sectors businesses. It operates through three segments: Investments, Property rental, and Beverages segments. Its investments segment includes investments held in shares. Its property rental segment engages in leasing of offices and parking spaces. Its beverages segment involves in production, import, and sale of alcoholic products. Excelsior United Development Companies Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4915784.presentation: Fan Milk PLC produces, manufactures, and distributes recombined milk and other dairy products in Ghana, Nigeria, Côte d'Ivoire, Togo, and Burkina Faso. It offers frozen dairy, juice, dairy drinkable and spoonable, and ice cream products under the FanVanille, FanYogo, SuperYogo, FanXtra, FanChoco, FanDango, FanJoy, FanMaxx, yogo, VIKING, Star, Goslo, FanIce, FANICE BUP, and Yaourt brand names. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. Fan Milk PLC is a subsidiary of Fan Milk International AS.

4560223.presentation: FDH Bank Plc provides banking services in Malawi. It operates through Personal and Business Banking; Corporate and Institutional Banking; Treasury & Investment Banking; Global Markets Trade Finance; and Other Operations segments. The company offers current, savings, foreign currency denominated, and Diaspora accounts, as well as term/fixed deposits; personal, business, corporate, and consumer loans; overdrafts and loans; and credit facilities. It also provides overdraft facilities, working capital, agriculture or seasonal, asset, capital expenditure, stock, insurance premium, and project financing; social cash transfers, cash in transit, revenue collection, and invoice discounting services; and bancassurance, advisory, legal, and property management services. In addition, the company offers FDH one-click, an electronic bulk payment solution; point of sale devices; mudaraba and murabaha banking solutions; foreign exchange and international trade transactions; custodial services; financial advice to corporate and private clients; and digital products and services. Further, it provides Debit cards; Mobile and internet banking; transaction banking; Investment Portfolio Management; Fixed Income and Money Market Trading; Liquidity Management; Custodial Services; Investment banking and Advisory services; Foreign currency trading; Letters of credits and guarantees; swaps; Foreign Financial institutions relationship management. FDH Bank Plc was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Blantyre, Malawi. FDH Bank Plc is a subsidiary of FDH Financial Holdings Limited.

4773036.presentation: Fincorp Investment Ltd. operates as an investment company, engages in holding of investments in the financial services sector in Mauritius. The company operates through Leasing and Investing segments. It also takes deposits and provides finance and operating leases for equipment and motor vehicles. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Fincorp Investment Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of MCB Group Limited.

4397234.nom: First National Bank of Botswana Limited
4397234.presentation: First National Bank of Botswana Limited provides various banking and related products and services to individuals, and large and small businesses in Botswana. The company operates through FNB Retail, FNB Commercial, RMB Corporate, and Treasury segments. It offers cheque, transactional savings, student, youth, commercial transact, and business accounts; treasury bills and bonds products; overdrafts; personal, employee, tertiary, graduate, home, and business loans, as well as vehicle and asset, commercial property, purchase order, and corporate finance services; loan schemes; and credit and debit cards. In addition, the company provides travel and investment foreign exchange solutions; Islamic finance and financial planning services; agricultural solutions, farming enterprise finance services, and farm risk insurance finance services; payment, funding, and cash management services to the public sector; and corporate products. Further, it offers funeral, debt protection, car, building, and travel insurance services; and online and cellphone banking services; and InContact Pro, an electronic platform for managing the money in business accounts. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana. First National Bank of Botswana Limited is a subsidiary of First National Bank Holdings (Botswana) Limited.

4395655.presentation: FirstRand Namibia Limited offers banking, insurance, and investment products and services in Namibia. The company provides digital enablement solutions, lending, and transactional products for retail banking; transactional banking, lending, trade and working capital solutions, advisory, structured finance, markets and structuring, merchant services and purchase order financing, and principle investing solutions and private equity for commercial banking; and investment banking solutions, including lending and advisory, global markets, and custody and transactional banking. It also offers wealth and asset management services; estate planning; and short and long-term insurance products and advice, affordable funeral cover, and comprehensive insurance solutions for buildings, motor vehicles, portable possessions, home contents, and personal liability. In addition, it provides home, personal, and mortgage loans; credit and debit cards, card acquiring, and credit facilities; vehicle and asset financing; unit trust investment and management; estate and trust services; insurance brokerage services; and eWallet, DigiPlus, CashTill, and CashPlus solutions. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia. FirstRand Namibia Limited is a subsidiary of FirstRand EMA Holdings Ltd.

4535017.presentation: FMBcapital Holdings Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate, investment, and retail banking products and services in Botswana, Malawi, Mauritius, Mozambique, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. The company offers financial products and services; cross-border and traditional banking; commercial banking; and shared services. FMBcapital Holdings Plc was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Blantyre, Malawi.

4996426.presentation: G4S (Botswana) Limited provides security solutions in Botswana and internationally. The company offers cash management and cash technology; facilities management services that includes cleaning services, rent collection and accounting, maintenance services, and management of properties; and security guarding services. It also provides alarm monitoring systems services, such as security alarms, electric fences, fire alarms, medical emergency alarms, illegal access signals, vehicle tracking, low battery power alerts, portable panic buttons, CCTV, and cable monitoring. In addition, the company offers security systems and services, including access control systems, alarm protection systems, perimeter protection, and robotics and autonomous technology. The company is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana. G4S (Botswana) Limited is a subsidiary of G4S International 105 (UK) Limited.

4988465.presentation: Gamma-Civic Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in contracting, building materials, lottery and gaming technology, hospitality, properties, and financial services in Mauritius and Madagascar. It operates through Contracting, Building Materials, Lottery and Gaming Technology, Corporate services, Real Estate and other segments. The Building Materials segment imports and sells cement in bulk or bags. The Contracting segment engages in the building and civil engineering works, asphalt production, and asphalt road works. The Properties segment develops and rents land and office buildings. The Lottery segment is involved in the lottery business. It also involved in property investment, cement, investment, secretarial, treasury, trading activities, and IT application businesses. Gamma-Civic Ltd was founded in 1961 and is based in Ebene, Mauritius.

4403436.presentation: GCB Bank Plc engages in the retail and corporate banking, consumer and commercial banking, and treasury activities in Ghana. The company offers current, savings, salary, student, deposit, call, and foreign currency and exchange accounts; personal, employee scheme, and short- and medium-term loans; and overdrafts. It also provides bulk cash collection and payroll solutions; import and export finance; letters of credit; bills for collection; money transfer and remittance; business development and advisory services; insurance; bonds and guarantees; and electronic, mobile and Internet banking services, as well as bancassurance services. In addition, the company offers debit cards; and fee collection services; and capital raising, financial advisory, and alternative/long-term assets services. Further, it provides swift and telegraphic transfer, travellers cheques, finware networking, cash management, small business finance scheme, money market, foreign drafts, trade, and documentary collection services. The company serves public and private corporates, financial institutions, and government and its agencies. GCB Bank Plc was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana.

4980452.activite: Oil and Gas Storage and Transportation
4980452.presentation: GOIL Plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the marketing of petroleum and other energy products and services in Ghana. The company offers marine gas oil, aviation fuel, mining diesel and lubricants, raw bitumen, polymer modified, Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and auto LP gas, premix fuel, and jet fuel; GOCARD; and fuel coupons. It also operates lube bay, fuel retailing, and non-fuels and convenience retail businesses. In addition, the company provides bunkering services, such as cargo sourcing, marketing, and credit management. Further, it is involved in operating as a bulk importer, storage facility, supplier, distributor, and trader of petroleum products; oil and gas operations; production, sale, and marketing of bitumen products; and provision of consultancy and related support, electronic payments, money transfers, and other IT-related business services. The company was formerly known as Ghana Oil Company. GOIL Plc was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4915347.presentation: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC manufactures, distributes, and sells spirits, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and other ancillary products. It offers its products under the Guinness, Malta Guinness, Johnnie Walker, Star, and Smirnoff Ice brands. Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Kumasi, Ghana. As of July 3, 2025, Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC operates as a subsidiary of Castel Frères SA.

26633783.presentation: Happy World Property Ltd engages in the rental of commercial property for office and retail space purposes in Mauritius. It also operates car parking facilities; and business centres offering serviced office facilities. The company was formerly known as Newton Development Ltd. Happy World Property Ltd was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4987925.presentation: Harel Mallac & Co. Ltd engages in the technology, chemicals, equipment and systems, travel, and investment and corporate businesses in Mauritius, Madagascar, Reunion, and Africa. The company produces, markets, sells, and distributes various products in hygiene and industrial cleaning, laundry and home care, beauty care, adhesive, and cementitious technologies under the Le Chat, Schwarzkopf, Pattex, Xtra, Le Petit Olivier, Supercroix, Gliss, Fa, Mir, Eclat Douceur, Tylon, Clearshield, K2R, Palette, Impec, Lirene, and Spaanjar brands; and chemical products and solutions for businesses. It also offers air control, ductwork, and fire safety solutions for architects, contractors, and building professionals under the Aldes, Hunter, Sikla, Dynair, York, and Gree brands; compressed air, refrigeration and material handling solutions, and Industry 4.0, smart building solutions under the Kaeser, Abac, BT Toyota Godrej, Bobcat, Terberg, Victa, Active, Cub Cadet, Wayne Gree, Sri, and Tegra brands; and printing and mailing, and cash-handling solutions, as well as implementation and support services. In addition, the company provides infrastructure and cloud, security, digital solutions, and building technologies for government, financial services, healthcare, education, retail, and enterprise; travel designer services; and renewable energy systems, and energy audits and management. Further, it manages commercial activities and airport operational supervision. Additionally, the company is involved in business process outsourcing and investment businesses; trading of chemicals, fertilizers, and general goods; waterproofing activities; acts as a general sale agent; distributor of consumer goods and IT products; retail sale of medical and orthopaedic goods; production and distribution of aeraulic; and provision of professional consultancy services. The company was founded in 1789 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Harel Mallac & Co. Ltd is a subsidiary of Société de Lerca.

4910708.presentation: Hords Plc researches, develops, produces, and sells cereals, detergents, and other food supplements in Ghana. It also provides disinfectants and laundry starch products. In addition, the company engages in the provision of agricultural consultancy; and importing and exporting of goods. It offers its products under the Brown Gold, Soyabetix, Cocobetix, and SparyStarch brand names. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Accra, Ghana.

4980618.presentation: Hotelest Limited, through its subsidiary, Constance Hotels Services Limited, owns and operates a group of hotels in Mauritius, the Maldives, the Seychelles, the Rodrigues, and Madagascar. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Centre De Flacq, Mauritius. Hotelest Limited is a subsidiary of BMH Ltd.

4515360.presentation: IBL Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in the agro and energy, building and engineering, commercial and distribution, financial, hospitality, life and technologies, logistics, seafood, and property businesses. The company retails and supplies consumer, healthcare, and industrial products; produces sugar cane; generates electricity from thermal and photovoltaic sources; and distributes and retails healthcare and wellbeing solutions. It also offers financial services, including banking, asset and wealth management, insurance, stockbroking, and private equity services; building, engineering, and contracting solutions; logistics, shipping, and aviation solutions; hospitality and tourism services; and fishmeal and fish oils from by-products, as well as engages in the fish storage activities. In addition, the company develops, invests, and manages real estate properties, including retail, office, industrial, and hospitality properties. It operates in Mauritius, Europe, the United States, Madagascar, Comoros, Seychelles & Reunion, Dubai, Africa, Australia, the Maldives, and internationally. IBL Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

11537792.presentation: ICON Properties plc, a property holding company, owns, leases, manages, and develops office, retail, residential and industrial properties in Malawi. It is also involved in the development of commercial, hospitality, specialized buildings, such as hospitals, rental of investment properties, services to tenants, and interest income business. ICON Properties plc was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Blantyre, Malawi.

4915961.presentation: Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar from sugar cane in Malawi. The company produces raw, brown, and refined sugars, as well as molasses. It also grows sugar cane. The company offers its products under BWANA SUKARI, ILLOVO, and WHITESPOON SUGAR brands. It exports its products to the regional African, European Union and United States of America (USA). Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Blantyre, Malawi. Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc operates as a subsidiary of SUCOMA Holdings Limited.

4911139.presentation: Innodis Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production of poultry and dairy products, poultry farming, animal feed manufacturing, and distribution and marketing of food and grocery products in Mauritius, Mozambique, and Seychelles. The company operates through three segments: Production Agro Business, Distribution and Others, and Production Others. It offers cheese, pasta and pasta sauces, sparkling drinks, coffee, tea and iced tea, potato chips, tinned fish, tinned corned mutton and beef, salt, fruit juice, basmati rice, cooking oil, ice cream and ice lollies, yoghurt, milk powder, milk, infant milk, spreads, fish balls, chicken franks, frozen fruits and vegetables, seafood, meat, chicken products, charcuterie, nappies and wipes, and pads and tampons. The company also operates Chicken Corner, Supercash, Saveurs Plus, and Farmshop channels. In addition, it is involved in rice milling; distribution of feeds and day old chicks; and broiler growing and processing, as well as investment and property development activities. Innodis Ltd was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4772927.presentation: Inqo Investments Limited is a venture capital firm and private investment firm specializing in buyouts, strategic acquisitions and secondary direct investing. The firm is a social venture, social impact investment company specializing in making investments in small medium size, middle market enterprises such as ecotourism, financial services, education, healthcare, argi-business, service and renewable energy sectors. It typically invests in Africa. The firm invests its personal capital. It prefers to take majority stake in the companies. Inqo Investments Limited was founded in 2001 and is based in Cape Town, South Africa.

4810871.presentation: Intravenous Infusions Plc, a pharmaceutical company, engages in the manufacturing and marketing of intravenous infusions and small volume injectables for therapeutic purposes in Ghana and the West African sub-region. It provides pethidine, such as chloroquine phosphate and quinine dihydrochloride injections. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Koforidua, Ghana.

5199985.presentation: Kolos Cement Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in unloading, storing, bagging, trading, and distribution of cement and other cementitious products in Mauritius. The company offers Kolos Slag Cement, Kolos Plus, Kolos, Kolos Eco-Plus, and Kolos Finish products. Kolos Cement Ltd was formerly known as Holcim (Mauritius) Ltd. and changed its name to Kolos Cement Ltd in September 2015. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Kolos Cement Ltd is a subsidiary of GAMMA CEMENT LTD.

13509961.presentation: Lavastone Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, acquires, develops, leases, and manages a portfolio of commercial and industrial properties in Mauritius and Rodrigues Island. It also holds properties; and develops residential units for sale. The company trades its properties under the Lavastone Properties brand name. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Lavastone Ltd is a subsidiary of Kingston Asset Management Ltd.

4810494.presentation: Leatt Corporation designs, develops, markets, and distributes personal protective equipment for participants of motor sports and leisure activities in South Africa and internationally. The company offers Leatt-Brace system, an injection molded neck protection system designed to prevent injuries to the cervical spine and neck. It also provides helmets for head and brain protection; and body armor products, including chest protectors, full upper body protectors, upper body protection vests, back protectors, knee braces, knee and elbow guards, off-road motorcycle boots, and mountain biking shoes. In addition, the company offers other products, parts, and accessories, such as goggles and hydrations bags, as well as apparel items that comprise suits, jackets, jerseys, pants, shorts, socks, gloves, sunglasses, and bicycle components; and aftermarket support products; toolbelt, duffel, gear, and helmet bags; backpacks, hats, and hydration kits; and casual clothing and caps. Further, it acts as the original equipment manufacturer for personal protective equipment sold by other brands. The company’s products are used by riders of motorcycles, bicycles, snowmobiles, and ATVs. It sells its products to customers through a network of distributors and retailers; and directs end consumers through digital channels and online store at leatt.com. The company was formerly known as Treadzone, Inc. and changed its name to Leatt Corporation in May 2005. Leatt Corporation was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Durbanville, South Africa.

4982686.presentation: Les Gaz Industriels Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes medical and industrial gases in bulk and cylinders in Mauritius and internationally. Its gas products include oxygen nitrogen, carbon dioxide, argon, hydrogen, helium, and acetylenes; and bulk gases, such as liquid nitrogen, liquid argon and liquid industrial and medical oxygen primarily used in hospitality, energy, construction, petrochemicals, chemicals, steelmaking, metals, and food and beverages industries. The company also provides medical gases, comprising medical oxygen, air, entonox, and nitrous oxide; gas equipment, including regulators, cutting torches, flashback arrestors, and various accessories and option; and distributes welding and cutting equipment and accessories. In addition, it supplies and installs gas reticulation systems; and distributes welding electrodes and medical and industrial equipment and consumables. Further, the company provides aftersales and maintenance, technical advice, showroom, and delivery and transport services. Les Gaz Industriels Limited was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Bell Village, Mauritius.

4911140.nom: Les Moulins de la Concorde Ltée
4911140.presentation: Les Moulins de la Concorde Ltée, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the milling of wheat in Mauritius. It offers wheat flours under the Blédor, Les Moulins, Concorde, Farine des Alizés, DoMix, and Optimale brands; and wheat bran and animal feed. The company is also involved in the production of unbaked frozen products. It exports its products to the Indian Ocean Islands and internationally. Les Moulins de la Concorde Ltée was founded in 1989 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4104267.presentation: Lesaka Technologies, Inc. provides financial technology (fintech) products and services through its platform in South Africa and internationally. It operates in three segments: Merchant, Consumer, and Enterprise. The company offers merchant solutions comprising merchant acquiring, integrated POS software and hardware for the hospitality industry, cash management and digitalization, and small cash advances and business credit solutions; and alternative digital products (ADP), including bill payments, international money transfers, and supplier enabled payments, as well as prepaid solutions for airtime, data, electricity, and gaming. It also provides low-cost EasyPay Everywhere transactional bank accounts, short-term personal loans, life and funeral insurance, and secure payout solutions; Adumo, a payments and commerce enablement platform that provides payment processing and integrated software solutions; and Recharger, a prepaid electricity platform that provides submetering administration and payment processing solutions. In addition, the company offers card acquiring, payment gateway, cash management, payment, digital wallet, and various value-added services. Further, it engages in the sale of POS devices, SIM cards, and other consumables; and the licensing of rights to use certain technology developed by the company. The company serves unbanked and underbanked consumers; small-to-medium and micro merchants; and corporate and government organizations, including banks, mobile network operators, and municipalities. The company was formerly known as Net 1 UEPS Technologies, Inc. and changed its name to Lesaka Technologies, Inc. in May 2022. Lesaka Technologies, Inc. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa.

7085034.presentation: Letlole La Rona Limited operates as a real estate investment company in Botswana. The company operates through Industrial, Commercial and Retail, and Residential segments. It invests, lease, create and develop, and sell properties, as well as engages in property investment and management. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

4558557.presentation: Letshego Africa Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides retail financial services in Botswana, Namibia, Mozambique, Lesotho, Eswatini, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Nigeria, and Ghana. The company is involved in banking and microfinance activities; and consumer lending business. It accepts demand accounts, savings accounts, and call and term deposits; and provides insurance services. The company was formerly known as Letshego Holdings Limited and changed its name to Letshego Africa Holdings Limited in December 2023. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

4913641.presentation: Livestock Feed Limited engages in processing animal feeds for animal production and aquaculture industries in Mauritius. The company offers broiler, layer, ruminant, horse, rabbit, pig, dog feeds, and other poultry feeds. It is also involved in storing and handling bulk commodities. In addition, the company engages in provision of support services to small farmers in the laying sector. Further, the company offers delivery, veterinary, and aftersales services. Livestock Feed Limited was founded in 1977 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. The company is a subsidiary of Management and Development Company Limited.

4988659.presentation: Lottotech Ltd operates the Mauritius National Lottery on behalf of the Government of Mauritius. The company offers a portfolio of games, including lottery and sports games under the Loto, The Football Pools, HotPicks, and Loto Vert names. It delivers its products through a network of retailers comprising small family-owned businesses. Lottotech Ltd was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Ebene, Mauritius.

4982367.presentation: Lux Island Resorts Ltd invests in and operates hotels and resorts in Mauritius, Reunion Island, and Maldives. The company operates resorts and hotels under the LUX Grand Baie, LUX Le Morne, LUX Grand Gaube, LUX Belle Mare, LUX Saint Gilles, LUX South Ari Atoll in the Indian Ocean; LUX Chongzuo, GUANGXI and LUX TeaHorse Road in Asia Pacific; LUX Marijani in Africa; and Tamassa Bel Ombre, and Ile des Deux Cocos brand names. It also operates a restaurant under the Emba Filao brand. The company was formerly known as Naïade Resorts Ltd and changed its name to Lux Island Resorts Ltd in December 2011.
