4997529.presentation: Maendeleo Bank PLC provides banking products and services in Tanzania. It offers deposit products, including savings and time deposits; lending products for individuals and micro small and medium enterprises; and fund transfer services. The company also facilitates payment systems through operating accounts and other accounts for individuals. In addition, it provides branch network, agency banking, mobile banking, internet banking, and other ICT-driven solutions. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4915675.presentation: Mauritius Cosmetics Limited manufactures and sells toothpaste, cosmetic products, creams, household products, toiletries, and perfumes in Mauritius and internationally. It manufactures and distributes toothpastes under the Ultradent, Dentaweiss, and Dentamax brands. The company also offers cosmetic products under the Kamill brand name; and furniture care products under the Poliboy Werke brand. In addition, it provides creams, lotions, perfumes, eau de colognes and toilettes, soaps, and detergents under the LE ROBUSTE and CALLINEA brands; liquid wash under the IZEE brand; and insect repellents. Further, the company engages in the distribution, retail, and export of consumer goods; rental of investment properties; investment in equity instruments. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Vacoas-Phoenix, Mauritius. Mauritius Cosmetics Limited is a subsidiary of Deramann Limited.

4911295.presentation: Mauritius Oil Refineries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in refining of crude edible oil in Mauritius. The company operates through Oil Products, Metal Cans & Plastic Containers, and Imported Food Products segments. It offers sunflower, soya, and vegetable oils under the Moroil brand; olive, sunflower, soya, maize, canola, oleisol, grapeseed, and pizza, as well as mayonnaise, salad dressings, sauces, mustard, and ketchup under the Lesieur brand; olive oils and vinaigrettes under the Puget brand; and olives, gherkins, and pickles under the Fragata brand. In addition, the company provides peeled tomatoes and pizza sauce under the Attianese brand; olive oil under the Font oliva brand; Peppadew brand; Moroil Rani; Denova; Walker Bay; Amadora; and cecil vinegar under the Soleil Brand. Further, it is involved in the packing and marketing of finished products; and manufacture of metal and plastic containers, as well as provides property rental services. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4917015.presentation: Mauritius Secondary Industries Limited engages in the rental activity of commercial and industrial buildings. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4536625.presentation: MCB Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking and financial products and services in Mauritius and internationally. It operates through three segments: Banking, Non-Banking Financial, and Other Investments. The company provides factoring and leasing services; corporate finance advisory; asset management; stock broking; private equity fund; and registry services. In addition, it is involved in credit finance, investment holding, investment dealing, investment product structuring, and real estate related activities, as well as property rental, ownership, and development activities. Further, the company offers commercial and investment advisory, collection, share and unit registrar, shared, leasing, secretarial, consulting, advisory, support, and maintenance services, as well as develops professionals and students. Additionally, it is involved in philatelic museum related services. MCB Group Limited was founded in 1838 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4913416.presentation: Medine Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planting of sugar cane in Mauritius. It operates in five segments: Agro, Casela, Sports and Hospitality, Property, and Education. The company is involved in the planting and milling of sugar cane for the production of sugar and by-products of sugar cane, including molasses and bagasses; landscaping and nursery business that includes cultivation of aromatics, indoor plants, and orchids; production of fruits and vegetables, such as potatoes, onions, and carrots; and ready to eat products, including seasonal fruits, dried herbs, and chips and snacks. It also provides nursery, pre-primary, primary school, secondary school, and higher education programs; and executive education services. In addition, the company engages in land promotion; residential and commercial property development activities; asset, property, and facilities management services; rental of office, and commercial buildings; construction and sale of villas; hotel resort operation; and other land transactions. Further, it operates Casela nature and leisure park, nature escapade, Tamarina golf and spa boutique hotel, SPARC sports and leisure center, and restaurants; and offers deer farming, nature escapade, forestry, management consultancy, event management, and travel and tourism services, as well as provides renewable energy services. The company was formerly known as The Medine Sugar Estates Company Limited and changed its name to Medine Limited in September 2009. Medine Limited was founded in 1911 and is based in Beau Bassin, Mauritius.

106320626.presentation: Medinotec Inc. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of medical devices used in cardiology and airway-related procedures in South Africa, the United States, and internationally. The company offers semi-compliant percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty balloon catheters, suction dissectors, aortic perfusion and dilation catheters, chronic total occlusion catheters, and silicone tracheal stents; and distributes a range of cardiology and renal dialysis products. It serves hospitals, clinics, third-party healthcare providers, distributors, and other institutions, including governmental healthcare programs and group purchasing organizations. The company sells its products through the network of distributors and direct sales force. Medinotec Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa.

4916520.presentation: Meridian Marshalls Holdings Limited engages in the education and research businesses. It also imports and exports educational materials. The company is based in Accra, Ghana.

4990935.presentation: Metal Fabricators of Zambia Plc, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells copper rods, and copper and aluminum electrical conductors in Zambia. Its products include aluminum overhead conductors, bare copper products, general wire insulated, and low-voltage and medium-voltage power cables. The company also sells telecommunications cables. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Luanshya, Zambia. Metal Fabricators of Zambia Plc is a subsidiary of Reunert International Investments (Mauritius) Limited.

4995019.presentation: MFD Group Limited provides logistics and shipping services worldwide. The company offers freight forwarding, customs clearing, dry and cold warehousing, industrial warehousing, and container services, as well as rents office space. It also provides transportation services for tipper trucks, crane-trucks, side loaders, and distribution vans, as well as bonded vehicles serving the airport. In addition, the company operates integrated logistics platform to cater various needs of the fishing industry, including transshipment of fish unloaded from fishing vessels, handling, sorting, grading, weighing, packing, labelling, and storage of the catch, processed products, and baits; and offers processing facilities for the transformation and value-adding of seafood products. MFD Group Limited is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4574330.presentation: Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc provides banking and related services in Tanzania. The company serves small and medium sized entrepreneurs, companies, SACCOS, institutions, such as schools, universities, hospitals, and corporations. Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

6218493.presentation: Mobile Telecommunications Limited operates as a mobile telecommunications company in Namibia. Mobile Telecommunications Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Windhoek, Namibia.

4977715.presentation: Morning Light Co Ltd owns a resort hotel under the Hilton Mauritius Resort & Spa name. It manages and operates a hotel under Hilton Worldwide Manage Limited. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Beau Bassin, Mauritius.

4864192.presentation: MPICO plc engages in the development, rental, and management of commercial, residential, retail, and industrial properties in Malawi. It has investment properties in Lilongwe, Blantyre, and other markets. The company rents its properties to the government and the private sector. MPICO plc was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Lilongwe, Malawi.

4672742.presentation: MUA Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial and insurance services for individuals and corporates in Mauritius, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and Rwanda. The company operates through General insurance, Life insurance, and Other segments. It offers casualty insurance products, including motor, liability, personal accident, health, financial and special risks; property insurance products, such as fire and allied perils, engineering, marine, and all risks; and life and pension insurance products, insurance premiums, investment income, as well as reinsurance products. The company also provides stock-broking, mutual fund and pension, pension fund administration, insurance management, and mutual funds management, investment services. In addition, it is involved in the property development and holding; investment dealer; and grant secured loans, conducts investment businesses. MUA Ltd was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius.

5000195.presentation: Mucoba Bank Plc, a community bank, provides banking products and financial services to low and medium income earners in Tanzania. The company offers savings and fixed/time deposits; loans, including individual business, group, and employee loans, as well as loans for savings and credits cooperative societies; and money transfer, social services, and insurance, and other services. The company was formerly known as Mufindi Community Bank Limited and changed its name to Mucoba Bank Plc in May 2014. Mucoba Bank Plc was founded in 1984 and is based in Iringa, Tanzania.

4997521.presentation: Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC engages personal and business banking services in Tanzania. The company offers time deposits accounts, personal current, foreign currency current and savings, student and tunu, semi fixed, child saving, and career accounts for individual customers; and business banking accounts, including corporate current, call deposit, and club/NGO current accounts. It also provides loan products comprising short and medium term, long term, personal, wastaafu, insurance premium financing, global education, and MSME business loans, as well as salary advances; and business overdrafts and bank guarantees. In addition, the company offers insurance products, such as fire and allied perils, liability, motor, marine, engineering, agricultural, and life insurance products. Further, the company engages in foreign exchange activities and other banking services, such as alternative delivery channels and money transfer services. Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4772645.presentation: Namibia Asset Management Limited is publicly owned investment manager. It provides its services to pension funds, provident funds, medical aid schemes and trusts, institutional, and individual investors. The firm manages separate client-focused portfolios. It launches and manages equity, fixed income, and balanced mutual funds. The firm invests in public equity, fixed income, and alternative investment markets across the globe with a focus on South Africa. For its alternative investments, the firm invests in listed properties. It primarily invests in growth at reasonable price stocks of large and medium market capitalization. The firm employs bottom-up stock picking approach to create its portfolios. It conducts in-house research to make its investments. Namibia Asset Management Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in Namibia. Namibia Asset Management Limited operates as a subsidiary of Coronation Investment Management Proprietary Limited

4912293.presentation: Namibia Breweries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in brewing and distribution of alcoholic beverages, and manufacture of soft drinks in Namibia and South Africa. The company offers alcoholic beers under the Windhoek Lager, Windhoek Draught, Windhoek Non-Alcoholic, Tafel Lager, Tafel Lite, Tafel Radler, Hansa Draught, Camelthorn, and Heineken brand names; sparkling and still bottled water under the Aqua Splash brand name; and mixers under the McKane brand name. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as South West Breweries Ltd and changed its name to Namibia Breweries Limited in 1990. Namibia Breweries Limited was incorporated in 1920 and is based in Windhoek, Namibia. The company operates as a subsidiary of NBL Investment Holdings (Proprietary) Limited.

4396290.presentation: National Bank of Malawi plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides retail, small and medium enterprise, corporate, and investment banking services in Malawi. It operates through four segments: Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, and Other Operations. The company offers various deposit products, including savings, current, special savers, student saver, call, step up professional and entrepreneur, and foreign currency denominated accounts, as well as fixed and short-term deposits. It also provides personal loan facilities, consumer loans, employer guaranteed loans, home improvements and mortgage finance, personal vehicle, and pay-day loans; farm infrastructure and implements loans; and finance lease, insurance premium finance, gold and asset finance services, as well as stockbroking, insurance, and pension administration services. Further, the company provides fund management, custodial, development and electronic banking, and training services; derivative products; corporate leasing; and credit and debit cards. It operates service centers in Malawi and Tanzania. National Bank of Malawi plc was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Blantyre, Malawi. National Bank of Malawi plc is a subsidiary of Press Corporation Plc.

4915000.presentation: National Breweries Plc engages in the production and sale of traditional African beer in Zambia. It offers beers under the Chibuku Shake Shake, Chibuku Super, Chibuku 1.5l Bottle, and Chibuku Super Extra Malt brand names. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia. National Breweries Plc is a subsidiary of Chibuku Breweries Limited.

15102886.presentation: National Investment Company Limited engages in the investment in shares of listed and unlisted companies, government securities, corporate bonds, and other financial instruments. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4772356.presentation: The National Investment Trust Ltd is a privately owned investment manager. The firm manages equity and fixed income mutual funds. The National Investment Trust Ltd was founded in March 18, 1993 and is based in Mauritius.

4560228.presentation: NBS Bank Plc provides retail and corporate banking services to individuals, small and medium enterprises (SME), corporates, and public institutions in Malawi. The company offers current, savings, sweep investment, foreign currency-denominated, and term deposit accounts. It also provides personal loans, employer supported loans, short term loans, advances to salaried employees, and mortgages; SME and corporate overdraft facility; SME loans, business loans, and order finance, as well as loans to business women; and asset finance loans, staff motor vehicle loan schemes, insurance premium finance, lease contracts, credit, and bancassurance products. In addition, it offers international trade services; digital channels and internet banking services; issues debt securities; derivatives for risk management purposes; and invests in liquid assets, such as short-term placement and corporate government debt securities. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Blantyre, Malawi. NBS Bank Plc is a subsidiary of NICO Holdings Plc.

4913590.presentation: Nestle Cote D'Ivoire S.A. processes cocoa beans, coffee, milk powder, baby foods and condensed milk products. The company is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Nestle Cote D'Ivoire S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Nestlé S.A.

4864331.presentation: New African Properties Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a public variable rate loan stock company. It owns a portfolio of retail and industrial properties in Botswana and Namibia. The company Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana.

4825271.presentation: New Mauritius Hotels Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates hotels in Mauritius, Europe, Morocco, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Hotel Operations; Tour Operating; Catering; and Property and Other segments. The Hotel Operations segment is involved in the operation of hotels, comprising provision of room services, food and beverages, and other services, such as spa, golf, laundry and boutique sales in Mauritius and Morocco. Its Tour Operating segment engages in the operation of a fleet of contract-hired vehicles, the organization of sightseeing tours, and rental of cars in Mauritius, France, the United Kingdom, Italy, and South Africa. The Catering segment offers flight and inland catering services for airline companies in Mauritius. Its Property and Others segment engages in the rental of hotel properties in Seychelles. The company also provides hotel training, real estate, and plant nursery services. New Mauritius Hotels Limited was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Curepipe, Mauritius.

4559522.presentation: NICO Holdings plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in general insurance, life assurance, pension administration, banking, corporate finance advisory, asset management, and information technology (IT) businesses in Malawi, Zambia, Uganda, and Mozambique. The company operates through Life Insurance and Pension Business, General Insurance Business, Banking Business, Asset Management, and Information Technology segments. It provides general insurance products, such as motor vehicle, building, road construction, liability, engineering, professional indemnity, marine hull, cargo, fire, loss of profits, agriculture, burglary, house-owners, householders, and personal accident products. The company also offers individual life insurance products, including endowment assurance with profits, cash generator endowment assurance with profits, savings protection policy, child saver, lien endowment assurance, and unit linked endowment; and group business insurance products comprising deposit administration, managed funds, group life assurance, group mortgage, group credit, and group funeral policies and annuities. In addition, it provides deposit products, credit facilities, visa credit, debit card services, trade finance services, foreign exchange products, women business programs, and other value-added services; pension solutions; and investment management services. Further, the company offers corporate and project finance advisory; IT services, such as IT managed, IT infrastructure, IT projects management, and software solutions; property advisory, management, development, and retail services; and hospitality services. NICO Holdings plc was founded in 1971 and is based in Blantyre, Malawi.

4912714.presentation: Nictus Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, retails motor vehicles, tires, furniture, electrical appliances, and home electronics in Namibia. It operates through three segments: Retail, Properties, and Insurance and Finance. The company sells multi-brand tires, retreaded tires, wheels, and allied services; and operates as a dealer of Isuzu, Suzuki, Subaru, Tafe and Hero vehicles, as well as provides automotive glass solutions, including windscreen replacement, chip repairs, and related rubber fitment solutions. In addition, it provides vehicle rental services, risk management solutions, and financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles and accessories. Further, the company operates as a specialist insurer; and invests in properties. Nictus Holdings Limited was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia.

4263768.presentation: NMB Bank Plc provides various banking products and services in Tanzania. It operates through Treasury, Retail Banking, and Wholesale Banking segments. Further, it offers payment solutions for bills payment, wage packaging, and corporate bulk payment processing; collection solutions; treasury services, including spot and forward foreign exchange contracts; foreign exchange swaps; interbank foreign exchange services; international payments; and money markets and investment solutions, such as government securities, fixed deposits, interbank cash, registry, and custody services. Additionally, the company provides credit and debit, and prepaid cards; structured, asset, project, and trade financing solutions; advisory services; and internet and mobile banking; cash management ,as well as property development and leasing services. It offers its products and services to retail customers, farmers, industrialists, small businesses, corporations, and institutions, as well as government institutions. NMB Bank Plc was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

9024220.presentation: Novus Properties Ltd, a real estate investment company, engages in property development for sale and/or rent in Mauritius. The company’s portfolio includes industrial and office space properties, such as warehouses, workshops, stores, offices, messroom, garage, mezzanine, restaurants, meeting rooms, parking spaces, and locker rooms. Novus Properties Ltd was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4798488.presentation: NSIA Banque Société Anonyme provides various banking products and services. In addition, it provides bank and prepaid cards; pensions and safe rental; factoring; auto, home, accident, death, multi-risk professional, professional civil liability, transport, key man, all construction risks, machine breakdown, all it risks, car, and health insurance solutions; and treasury management solutions. 4989920.presentation: Numeral Limited, an investment holding company, engages in biotech, health and pharmaceutical, and financial businesses in Mauritius. 101243340.presentation: Oceanarium (Mauritius) Ltd operates aquarium in Mauritius. The company offers various education and conservation programmes. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Oceanarium (Mauritius) Ltd is a subsidiary of Société Aquarius.

7089551.presentation: Olympia Capital Corporation Limited manufactures and sells vinyl floor tiles, aluminum and PVC windows, and chemicals products in Botswana and South Africa. 109411958.presentation: Orange CI operates as a telecommunication provider for individuals and businesses in the Ivory Coast, Liberia, and Burkina Faso. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Abidjan, the Ivory Coast. Orange CI operates as a subsidiary of Orange S.A.

4863813.presentation: Oryx Properties Limited is a real estate investment trust managed by Oryx Management Services (Pty) Ltd. 4913752.presentation: Palmci, S.A. engages in the management of oil palm plantations in Ivory Coast. The company produces and sells olein, crude palm and palm kernel oil. 4978370.presentation: Paper Converting Co. Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of tissue and toilet papers in Mauritius and internationally. The company is involved in manufacturing boots, gloves, recycling paper bags, and safety equipment, as well as in the management and investment business. It markets its products under the Kleenex, Carlton, and Scottex brand names. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Vacoas-Phoenix, Mauritius. Paper Converting Co. Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Deramann Limited.

8008024.presentation: Paratus Namibia Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the information and communications technology industry. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia.

4914077.presentation: Phoenix Beverages Limited, an investment holding company, engages in production and sale of alcoholic and non-alcoholic products in Mauritius and internationally.
