4577077.presentation: Promotion and Development Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property development business in Mauritius. It operates through Property, Investments, and Security segments. The company rents properties. It is also involved in the provision of guarding services, installation and monitoring of alarm systems, cash in transit, armed sentry, and security and property protection services, as well as rental of alarm systems; sales of equipment; and investment in shares activities. Promotion and Development Ltd was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4976784.activite: Oil and Gas Refining and Marketing
4976784.presentation: Puma Energy Zambia Plc engages in marketing and distribution of petroleum products in Zambia. The company operates through Retail, Business to Business, Aviation, and Lubricants segments. It offers fuel, lubricants, and other oil products. The company was formerly known as BP Zambia plc and changed its name to Puma Energy Zambia Plc in June 2011. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia. Puma Energy Zambia Plc is a subsidiary of Puma Energy (Ireland) Holdings Limited.

4911158.presentation: Quality Beverages Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of beverages in Mauritius. The company operates through two segments, Manufacturing and Trading, and Advertising. It engages in the bottling and distribution of carbonated and non-carbonated beverages; distribution of Lavazza coffee; manufacturing and selling of oils and fats; and trading of food products. The company also offers butter, oils, and fats under Mil, Tara Spread, Vita Vanaspati, Selection Du Chef, Hazella, and Butterfly brand names; snacks under the Lay’s, Doritos, Ruffles, and Cheetos brand names; cereals under the Quaker, Bokomo, and Tia’s brand names; confectionery and bakery products under the Switz and Banquet d’Or brand names; ingredients under Lesaffre and Sweet Dodo brand names; frozen and canned veg under the Classico brand name; delicatessen products under the AlShifa brand names, and rice under the cercle vert brand name. In addition, it offers beverages under the Pepsi, 7up, Mirinda, Fiesta, Evervess, Almarai Milk, Ceres, Lipton iced tea, Sparky drink, and Vital Eau de Source brand names. Further, the company manufactures and supplies advertising materials, including luminous signs, kiosks, and banners, as well as rents signs and media. Additionally, it designs and manufactures visual solutions, such as signage, billboards, totem signs, custom flags, and various types of displays; trades in liquid petroleum gas; and manufactures and distributes laundry and toilet soaps, detergents and cosmetics and distribution of imported fast-moving consumer goods, including food items. The company also engages in manufacturing of water dispensers under the VITAL FONTAINES brand name. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Quatre Bornes, Mauritius. Quality Beverages Limited operates as a subsidiary of Currimjee Industries Limited.

4863862.presentation: RDC Properties Limited operates as a real estate investment, management, and development company in Botswana, South Africa, and Croatia. The company’s portfolio includes office buildings, retail centers, industrial parks, hotels, and residential developments, as well as commercial and retail property. It also offers property rental services. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

4863855.presentation: Real Estate Investments Zambia PLC, together with its subsidiaries, invests, develops, and restructures commercial, residential, and non-commercial property for commercial letting in Zambia. It operates in two segments, Retail, and Office and Residential. It owns a portfolio of office, retail, industrial, and residential real estate. The company was formerly known as Farmers House PLC and changed its name to Real Estate Investments Zambia PLC in 2012. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia.

4430237.presentation: Republic Bank (Ghana) PLC provides investment banking, corporate banking, retail banking, mortgage banking, asset management, and property management and development services in Ghana. The company operates through four segments: Retail Banking, Mortgage Banking, Corporate Banking, and Microfinance Banking. It offers savings and current account; deposit products; rent advance, auto, personal, credit and consumer, and home loans; investment banking services, including asset management, financial advisory, brokerage, and managed funds services; private banking services; corporate banking services, such as working capital finance, capital expenditure/asset financing, structured trade finance, bank guarantees, and project financing services; bancassurance products; and institutional banking services. The company also provides mortgage banking products consisting of home equity, home purchase, home completion, and home improvement mortgages; and buy, build, and own a home, as well as public sector home schemes. In addition, it offers money transfer, bill payment, foreign trade, collection, custody, letters of credit, document collections, overdraft, foreign currency, fund management, institutional finance, and computer services, as well as E-banking services comprising ATM, SMS, internet banking, transaction alerts, bill payments, visa cards, and E-bouquet services. The company was formerly known as HFC Bank (Ghana) Limited and changed its name to Republic Bank (Ghana) Limited in April 2018. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. Republic Bank (Ghana) Limited is a subsidiary of Republic Financial Holdings Limited.

4993838.presentation: RHT Holding Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of public transport services in Mauritius, Uganda, and Zambia. It operates through Mobility, Investments, and Technology segments. The company is also involved in the provision of chauffeur services; information technology services; and motoring training, as well as maintenance and servicing of vehicles. In addition, it invests in properties and equities. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Rose Hill, Mauritius.

4585173.presentation: SBM Holdings Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides various commercial banking and financial services to retail and corporate customers. It offers savings and current accounts; term deposits; foreign currency short and long term deposit; debit, credit, and prepaid card; home, boost, personal, student, auto lease, eco, and zero interest loan; working capital finance and project finance; trade, corporate, and structured finance, as well as treasury products and services, fixed income products, foreign exchange services, derivatives, and dual currency deposits. The company also provides financial services, such as trading and structuring, asset management, registry and valuation services, corporate finance, insurance agency, and factoring; private wealth management and banking services; custodian services; merchant corner; microfinance; dormant account reactivation; and SME banking services. SBM Holdings Ltd was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4418173.presentation: SBN Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides banking and financial services to individual customers and small to medium-sized enterprises in Namibia. It operates through Personal and Private Banking; Business & Commercial Banking; and Corporate & Investment Banking segments. It offers achiever, basic and classic bank, digital wallets, personal transactions, and private banking accounts. The company also provides bank guarantees, business overdraft, business revolving credit plan, contract finance, dealer floor plans, property finance, contract finance, trade finance, bank guarantees, letters of credit, invoice discounting, and medium term loans, as well as vehicle asset finance, personal, revolving, home, and student loans. In addition, it offers credit and debit cards; and internet banking services. The company was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia. SBN Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Standard Bank Group Limited.

6372105.presentation: Scancom Plc provides telecommunications services in Ghana. The company operates through Network services, Interconnect and roaming, Digital and Fintech, and Mobile, devices and accessories segments. It offers voice, data, mobile financial, and enterprise solutions, as well as consultancy and support services in the areas of mobile banking, payment services, and fintech. The company also provides communications, digital solutions, connectivity solutions, cloud and hosting services, digital platforms, managed mobility, Internet, security services. Its products include internet and connectivity solutions, such as leased lines, dedicated internet services, sponsored data, MTN global MPLS, MTN Yello Biz, business broadband, MTN SD -WAN, MTN Wi-Fi extenders, and MTN APN sim cards; digital solutions, including business manager, business messenger, web-wiz, USSD, bulk SMS, and mobile advertising services; and mobile solution, which include association bundle, SME plus, corporate postpaid, adwumapa bundle, groupshare, and corporate postpaid solutions. In addition, the company offers money transfers; airtime topups; bill payments; general payments; bulk payment payroll; school fees payments; savings and investment options; international remittances; insurance products; and ATM cash-outs through MTN Mobile Money platform, as well as links to bank accounts. Further, it sells mobile handset devices and accessories; and offers leased lines providing connectivity, wireless broad band services, infrastructure sharing, infrastructure rentals, and ICT services. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. Scancom Plc operates as a subsidiary of Investcom LLC.

5454397.presentation: Seed Co International Limited engages in the processing of agricultural seeds in Botswana, Mozambique, South Africa, Angola, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi, Zambia, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, and Tanzania. The company offers maize and soybean seeds, as well as other seeds, including wheat, sorghum, barley, rice, groundnuts, cowpeas, and beans. The company also provides soybeans, sugar beans and vegetable seeds. It sells its products under the Seed Co brand name. Seed Co International Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana.

4772397.presentation: Sefalana Holding Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of fast-moving consumer goods in Botswana, Australia, Zambia, South Africa, Lesotho, and Namibia. The company operates through four segments: Trading - Consumer Goods, Trading - Others, Manufacturing, and Property. It manages retail supermarkets under the Sefalana Shopper name; convenience stores under the Sefalana Quick name; cash and carry outlets under the Sefalana Cash & Carry name; hyper stores under the Sefalana Hyper name; liquor stores under the Sefalana Liquor name; retail hybrid store under The BIG One name; cigarette distribution outlet under the Capital Tobacco name; fuel filling station under the Puma and Caltex franchise; stores under the Metro name; and catering business under the Sefalana Catering name. The company also produces and sells sarona samp; sechaba mabele; soya sorghum weaning food for infants; soya sorghum enriched foods; tholo malt; tsabotlhe, a soya sorghum extruded product; maatla, an enriched maize meal product; and long life, ultra-high temperature milk under the Delta Fresh and A Star brands. In addition, it sells agricultural and construction equipment, automotive products, and provides its after-sale services, as well as operates as a franchised local representative for MAN, Honda, Daewoo, and Tata vehicles, which include light and heavy commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, trucks, special-purpose vehicles, and buses. Further, the company leases office blocks, workshops, factories, and warehouses; and manufactures laundry and bath soaps under the Marang, Olga, and Fusion brand names. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

19116725.presentation: Semaris Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in the property development business in Mauritius, Morocco, and Seychelles. It owns and develops luxury residential real estate assets; and sells villas. The company was formerly known as Alto Development Ltd and changed its name to Semaris Ltd in August 2018. Semaris Ltd was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Curepipe, Mauritius.

4423302.presentation: SIC Insurance PLC engages in the provision of non-life insurance business in Ghana. The company operates through the Motor, Fire, Accident, Marine & Aviation, Bonds, and Engineering segments. It offers motor insurance, including third-party only, comprehensive, and third-party fire and theft coverage; fire and allied peril; general accident insurance comprising unforeseen, accidental, and sudden loss of or damage to property and injury or death to persons; marine insurance for goods carried on board ships, vessels, and aircraft; and aviation insurance consisting of the manufacture, ownership, operation, and maintenance risks of aircraft and aviation facilities. The company also offers workmen's compensation insurance, general bonds, travel insurance, education, and engineering and construction insurance. In addition, it provides brokerage services. SIC Insurance PLC was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana.

4991190.nom: SICABLE - Société Ivoirienne De Cables S.A.
4991190.presentation: SICABLE - Société Ivoirienne De Cables S.A. manufactures and sells electric cables in Ivory Coast. It offers household wires and cables, rigid industrial cables, overhead cables, bare conductors, and underground cables. The company also distributes products under the PRYSMIAN and DRAKA brands. In addition, the company offers low voltage products for industry, buildings, infrastructure, overhead, and underground networks applications; and HTA products used for the transport of energy using aluminum alloy conductors. The company is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. SICABLE - Société Ivoirienne De Cables S.A. is a subsidiary of Prysmian Cables Et Sys France.

4913656.nom: Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas Société anonyme
4913656.presentation: Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas Société anonyme engages in processing and marketing of natural rubber. It also engages in the oil palm and sugarcane business. In addition, it operates rubber plantations. Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas Société anonyme was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast.

4989663.nom: Societe d Etudes et de Travaux pour l Afrique de l Ouest
4989663.presentation: Societe d Etudes et de Travaux pour l Afrique de l Ouest supports construction projects throughout their value chain from upstream to downstream. It offers range of projects, such as hotels, healthcare institutions, universities and schools, housing, data centers, offices, shopping centers, and transport terminals. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast.

4914089.nom: Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique
4914089.presentation: Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique engages in the manufacture and sale of beer, soft drinks, mineral water, alcomixes, and energy drink products. It operates malt houses, breweries, and lemonades; and manufactures preforms. The company was formerly known as Societe de Limonaderies et Brasseries d'Afrique SA and changed its name to Societe de Limonaderies et de Boissons Rafraichissantes d'Afrique in May 2023. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast.

4911647.nom: Société des Caoutchoucs de Grand-Béréby Société Anonyme
4911647.presentation: Société des Caoutchoucs de Grand-Béréby Société Anonyme engages in the plantation and cultivation of rubber trees in Grand-Béréby, Ivory Coast. It is also involved in the transformation of ulatexen into industrial rubber; planting and cultivation of oil palm; and production of palm oil and palm kernel oil. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in San-Pedro, Ivory Coast. Société des Caoutchoucs de Grand-Béréby Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Bereby-Finances (Befin) SA.

4251104.nom: Société Générale Côte d'Ivoire - Société Anonyme
4251104.presentation: Société Générale Côte d'Ivoire - Société Anonyme provides banking products and services to businesses, individuals, professionals, companies, and financial institutions in Ivory Coast. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Société Générale Côte d'Ivoire - Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Société Générale Société anonyme.

4251090.presentation: Societe Generale Ghana PLC engages in the provision of retail, corporate, and investment banking services in Ghana. The company operates through three segments: Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, and Treasury. The company offers current and savings accounts; consumer appliance, institutional, auto, home, chat, CAGD, and cash covered loans, as well as relief credit; treasury services, overdrafts, revolving advance, factoring, trade finance, and working capital loans; term loans comprising asset financing, finance leasing, and project financing; safe deposit boxes; and insurance products comprising drive, cash, home, eduflex, and funeral insurance. It also provides cash management services, including merchant/point-of-sale, terminal acquiring, bill/fees payment, reporting, account, flow and liquidity management, cash, and electronic banking services, as well as business cards; working capital finance that include project and infrastructure, industrial project, acquisition, and structured corporate finance, as well as syndicated loans and leverage buy outs; and trade finance services comprising letters of credit, guarantees, documentary collection, standby letters of credit, and avalised bills and bills discounting; and treasury services. In addition, the company offers investment banking services, as well as invests in liquid assets, such as short-term placements and government debt securities. It serves individuals, clients, institutional clients, and businesses. The company was formerly known as Societe Generale Ghana Limited and changed its name to Societe Generale Ghana PLC. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. Societe Generale Ghana PLC operates as a subsidiary of SG Financial Services Holding SA.

4406214.presentation: Société Ivoirienne de Banque S.A. provides various banking products and services to individuals, professionals, and businesses in Ivory Coast. It offers deposit, current, and savings accounts; cards; bancassurance products; financing solutions; cash management and money transfer services; documentary credit, documentary collection, stand-by letter of credit, transfer, and repatriation services; and ATM, SMS, internet, and mobile banking services. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Société Ivoirienne de Banque S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Attijari West Africa.

4914120.nom: Societe Ivoirienne Des Tabacs S A
4914120.presentation: Societe Ivoirienne Des Tabacs S A operates as a subsidiary of Imperial Tobacco Group plc.

4985283.nom: Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme
4985283.activite: Oil and Gas Refining and Marketing
4985283.presentation: Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme processes heavy bitumen crude in Africa. The company offers bitumen and distillates. It exports bitumen to Nigeria, Ghana, Gabon, Senegal, Cameroon, Mauritania, Angola Guinea Conakry, Togo, Benim, and DRC. Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast.

4999658.presentation: Sonatel SA, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications services in Senegal, Mali, Guinea Bissau, Guinea Conakry, and Sierra Leone. The company offers fixed and mobile communications, internet, data transmission, and other value-added services, as well as mobile financial services. It serves individual and business customers, and telecommunications operators. Sonatel SA was founded in 1985 and is based in Dakar, Senegal.

4418536.presentation: Standard Bank PLC provides banking and other related services in Malawi. It operates through Corporate and Investment Banking, Treasury and Capital Management, Personal and Private Banking, and Business and Commercial Clients segments. It offers current, fixed deposit, call, SME, and contract save accounts; fixed term, home, pay day, revolving term, business revolving credit, business term, commercial property, medium term, digital, and working capital loans; business overdraft; and trade, and vehicle and asset financing services. The company also provides debit cards; investment products and advisory services; bancassurance services; offshore banking services; and ATM, Internet, telephone, and electronic banking services, as well as treasury and capital management. In addition, it offers corporate and investment banking products and services comprising foreign exchange services, commodities, debt securities, and equities trading services; transactional banking, trade finance, and investor services; and equity investment, advisory, project finance, structured finance, structured trade finance, corporate lending, primary market, acquisition and finance, property finance, and asset and wealth management services to larger corporates, financial institutions, and international counterparties. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Lilongwe, Malawi. Standard Bank PLC is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

4250387.presentation: Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited provides banking products and services in Botswana. It operates through Corporate and Investment Banking; and Wealth & Retail Banking segments. The company offers personal banking products and services, such as banking, current, call, and savings accounts; fixed deposits; personal and home loans; credit cards; foreign exchange, mutual funds, and fixed income securities; and wealth lending products. It also provides lending, trade finance, cash management, securities services, risk management, capital raising, corporate finance solutions and advisory services, and trade and working capital solutions, as well as Islamic banking. In addition, the company offers international banking; global private banking; priority private and banking; supply chain financing; protection and insurance; business loans; women-led businesses; business banking products and services, including business current, savings, and call accounts; yield enhancement solutions, including fixed and term, and fixed income deposit accounts; foreign exchange forwards; and business fixed income deposit. The company was founded in 1897 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana. Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

4401017.presentation: Standard Chartered Bank Ghana PLC provides various banking products and services. It operates through three segments: Corporate and Investment Banking, Wealth and Retail Banking, and Standard Chartered Wealth Management. The company offers current and saving accounts, fixed deposit, secured and unsecured loans, fixed income securities, and mutual funds for individuals. It also provides macro and credit trading; lending and financial solutions, capital markets and advisory, payments and liquidity, trade and working capital, and securities and prime services; and investments, bancassurance, wealth advice, and portfolio management, as well as debit cards; credit cards; online and mobile banking; and ATM services. Standard Chartered Bank Ghana PLC was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. The company operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

4431474.presentation: Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc provides various banking products and services to individuals and companies in Zambia. The company offers current and savings, foreign currency, and fixed deposit accounts; fixed term deposits; term loans, personal loans, trade and working capital solutions, and business overdrafts; debit cards; investment services, including mutual funds, fixed income securities, wealth lending, foreign exchange, and international banking; cash management and other transaction services. It also offers group life assurance, and motor and houseowner/householder insurance products; mobile, online, and agent banking services; estatements; cash deposit machines; payment, payroll, and trade services; and foreign exchange services. The company serves corporate, personal, priority, and business clients. Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia. Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

4913812.presentation: Sucrivoire SA engages in the cultivation and operation of sugar cane plantation in Ivory Coast. It offers granulated sugar, such as brown, blond, and white, as well as lumps. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Sucrivoire SA operates as a subsidiary of SIFCA SARL.

4219265.presentation: Sun Limited operates in the tourism sector. The company operates and manages seven properties, including Shangri-La’s Le Touessrok Resort & Spa, Four Seasons Resort Mauritius at Anahita, Long Beach, Sugar Beach, La Pirogue, Ambre, and Ile aux cerfs in Mauritius. It engages in operation golf and restaurant, logistics, retail, training, laundry, tour operator, marketing, and procurement activities. The company was formerly known as Sun Resorts Limited and changed its name to Sun Limited in September 2015. Sun Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Ebene, the Republic of Mauritius. Sun Limited is a subsidiary of CIEL Limited.

4980715.presentation: Sunbird Tourism Plc engages in the hospitality business in Malawi, Africa, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Room Income, Catering Income, and Other Services. The company owns, operates, and manages hotel properties. It also operates touts and travel, which provides travel related, trip planning, ticketing, and other services. In addition, the company offers hotel accommodation and catering services. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Blantyre, Malawi. Sunbird Tourism Plc is a subsidiary of MDC Limited.

4203668.presentation: Swan General Ltd engages in underwriting of short-term insurance business in Mauritius. It operates through Life, General, and Others segments. The company offers protect property and liability, specialty risks, motor fleet, marine, health, keyman and partnership, life, travel, group and life, car, home, health, travel, and boat insurances. It also provides retirement solutions, actuarial services, and defined contribution pension schemes, as well as offers education and retirement plans. In addition, the company provides loans and personal loans; prosper, wealth management, investment plans, and securities; prosper, wealth management, investment plans and management, and securities services. The company was formerly known as Swan Insurance Company Limited and changed its name to Swan General Ltd in April 2015. Swan General Ltd was founded in 1855 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4430458.presentation: Swan Life Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in life insurance, pensions, actuarial, and investment businesses in Mauritius. The company offers life, car, home, health, travel, and boat insurance products; education and retirement plans; personal and other loans; and investment plans, wealth management, and securities services for individuals. It also provides property and liability, specialty risks, motor fleet, marine, health, keyman and partnership, travel, and life and group life insurance products for businesses. In addition, the company offers retirement solutions; business, investment-backed, home, and personal, as well as commercial loans; and investment management and securities services for corporate clients. Further, it provides actuarial consulting services on pensions, insurance, risk management, and expected credit losses; and pension schemes. Additionally, the company offers property management, pension and fund administration, stockbroking, asset and fund management, investment consulting, brokerage, forex, and corporate advisory services. Furthermore, it provides insurance management, administration and financial, audit and actuarial, tax advisory, regulatory and compliance, reinsurance, and investment management services for international clients. The company was formerly known as The Anglo Mauritius Assurance Society Limited and changed its name to Swan Life Ltd in April 2015. The company was founded in 1855 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Swan Life Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Swan General Ltd.

4994729.presentation: Swissport Tanzania Plc provides airport ground and cargo handling, and airport lounge services in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company operates through three segments: Ground Handling Services, Cargo Handling Services, and Lounge business. It offers passenger services, such as passenger check-in and gate, passenger mobility, and security services, as well as executive lounges and executive aviation services. The company also provides air cargo handling services that consist of general and special cargo handling, hub handling, forwarder handling, pharma centres, handling perishables, express, and e-commerce services. In addition, it offers ramp handling services, including turnaround coordination, aircraft movement, cleaning, load sheet production, and de-icing and fueling; passenger services, including check-in and gate operations, transfer services, assistance for passengers with reduced mobility, and security support; baggage services, including lost and found, lost property, and repair or replacement solutions; and fuelling services, including pipeline management, GSE maintenance and refueling, and fuel consortium financial management. Swissport Tanzania Plc was founded in 1984 and is based in Dar es Salaam, the United Republic of Tanzania. Swissport Tanzania Plc operates as a subsidiary of Swissport International Ltd.

4864515.presentation: Tadvest Limited is a private equity firm. The firm also invests in listed equity and direct and indirect property holdings. It makes investments in companies both in the pre-Initial Public Offering stage and also the listed ones. It seeks to in invest in Africa and globally. Tadvest Limited was founded in 2014 and is based in Ebene, Mauritius with additional offices in Sandton, South Africa and Limassol, Cyprus.

4910292.presentation: Tanzania Breweries Public Limited Company manufactures, sells, and distributes beer alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in Tanzania and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Beer, and Wines and Spirits. It offers beers, wines, liquors, and spirits. The company sells its products under the Corona Extra, Stella Artois, Safari Lager, Kilimanjaro lager, Kilimanjaro light, Balimi Extra, Castle lite, Castle lager, Castle Milk Stout, Brutal Fruit, Flying Fish, Redds, Grand Malt, Konyagi Lager, Bingwa, and Eagle Lager, as well as Dodoma sweet rose, Dodoma dry red, Dodoma dry white, Imagi red, Zanzi, Konyagi, and Valeur brands. Tanzania Breweries Public Limited was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4910295.presentation: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company manufactures, distributes, markets, and sells cigarettes in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers its products under Embassy, Crescent and Star, Portsman, Sweet Menthol, Club, Camel, Winston, Monte Carlo, and LD brands. It also distributes Shisha under the Nakhla brand. The company exports its products to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Southern Africa, and Namibia. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, the United Republic of Tanzania. Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of JT International Company Netherlands B.V.

4466009.nom: Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company
4466009.presentation: Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company manufactures and sells cement in Tanzania and internationally. The company offers cement products under the Twiga Ordinary, Twiga Plus, Twiga Extra, Twiga Jenga, Twiga Super, and Twiga Mega names. It serves constructions and government infrastructure projects; producers of ready-mixed concrete; and the general public through distributorship network. The company exports its products to various countries in the Central and East African Sub-Region. The company was founded in 1959 and is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of Scancem International DA.

4910410.presentation: Tatepa Public Limited Company, together with its subsidiaries, grows, processes, and sells tea in Tanzania and internationally. It also engages in growing and packaging avocadoes. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Mbeya, Tanzania.

4999791.presentation: Telekom Networks Malawi plc provides telecommunication services to enterprises and individual customers in Malawi. It operates in two segments, Telecommunications Services and Mobile Money Services. The company provides a range of communication products and services, including voice, bonuses, bundles, international dialing and roaming, and value-added services, as well as prepaid tariff plans. It also offers prepaid, data, international incoming, messaging, enterprise business, postpaid, and roaming services. In addition, the company provides internet and virtual private network; session initiation protocol and PBX; home broadband; hosting; managed cloud; mobile phone contracts; mobile advertising; and 5G solutions, as well as communications solutions. Further, it offers a range of mobile money services, including money transfers, cash withdrawals, bill payments, cash deposits, and merchant payments. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Blantyre, Malawi.

4864520.presentation: The Far Property Company Limited engages in the property rental and asset management businesses Botswana, South Africa, and Zambia. The company operates through Residential Properties, Commercial Properties, Industrial Properties, and Other segments. It offers retail, commercial, industrial, and residential properties for rent. The Far Property Company Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Gaborone, Botswana.

4981055.nom: The Mauritius Chemical and Fertilizer Industry Limited
4981055.presentation: The Mauritius Chemical and Fertilizer Industry Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing and sale of NPK complex fertilizers in Mauritius, Madagascar, and other African countries. The company operates through Agrochemicals, Industrial, Aqua & Lab, and International segments. It offers agri solutions including soil nutrition, crop protection, equipment, and precision agriculture solutions. The company also provides aqua solutions, such as pool treatment, desalination, solid and liquid separation, and water purification solution, as well as air quality, bio augmentation, and industrial process technologies; and industry solutions comprising food and beverages, hygiene and sanitation, textile, paints and coating, fiberglass and resins, plastic converters, construction materials, and industrial chemicals. In addition, it offers lab solutions, including food quality and agro science testing, as well as water, air, and soil testing services. Further, the company is involved in blending and trading of chemicals, fertilizers, and general goods; manufacture of pharmaceuticals; and waterproofing activities. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius. The Mauritius Chemical and Fertilizer Industry Limited operates as a subsidiary of Harel Mallac & Co. Ltd.

4771949.nom: The Mauritius Development Investment Trust Company Limited
4771949.presentation: The Mauritius Development Investment Trust Company Limited operates as an approved investment institution with the objective of holding and managing securities in Mauritius. The firm invests in stocks where their respective prices have fallen below their fundamentals and subscribes to rights issues of shares, bonds and depositary receipts with good growth potentials. It has a portfolio of investments in 104 local companies operating in the investment holdings, funds and trust companies, commerce, sugar, property development, leisure and hotels, industry, banks, insurance and other finance, overseas and transport sectors of the Mauritian economy. The Mauritius Development Investment Trust Company Limited was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Port-Louis, Mauritius.

4910651.nom: The Union Sugar Estates Company Limited
4910651.presentation: The Union Sugar Estates Company Limited engages in the growing and cultivation of sugar cane and other agricultural products in Mauritius. It also offers management services. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is based in Floreal, Mauritius.

4985453.presentation: The United Basalt Products Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells building materials primarily in Mauritius, Sri Lanka, and Réunion. The company operates through the Building Materials and Agriculture segments. Its products primarily include aggregates, rocksand, and concrete blocks. The company also offers building materials, such as smart and classic blocks, aggregates, and rock sand; prefabricated products, including claustra, drains, kerbs, hollow block, precast slabs, beams, blocks for retention use, mega blocks, and pipes; ready-to-use dry mortars; flooring, wall covering, and roofing decorative products; and various concrete building components, including paving-blocks and roof tiles, ready-mixed concrete, imported floor and wall tiles, sanitary ware and home building products, fittings, tools, and garden accessories. In addition, it is involved in the cultivation of sugar cane, vegetables, and plants; engineering works; sale of land and agricultural products; and provision of landscaping, workshop, and contracting services, as well as leisure activities. The United Basalt Products Limited was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Quatre Bornes, Mauritius.

4466036.presentation: TOL Gases Limited produces and distributes industrial gases, medical gases, and related accessories in Tanzania. The company offers gases, such as ammonia, dry ice, nitrogen, compressed carbon dioxide, industrial oxygen, helium, medical/compressed air, medical oxygen, acetylene, argon, nitrous oxide, and argo shield. It also provides gas welding and cutting products, including acetylene regulators, flashback arrestor acetylene and oxygen with brand, flashback arrestor oxygen, blue hose pipes, copper coated mild steel OK 98.7 gas rods, coupling nuts and nipple RHS, cutting attachments and nozzles, cutting torches, double stage oxygen regulators, flip front helmets, nozzle cleaners, oxygen regulators, shanks, red hose pipe-acetylenes, spark lighters, and spindle keys. In addition, the company offers arc welding equipment comprising earth clamps, electrode holders, ESAB buddy arcs, gouging carbons, mask LCD eclipses, mig wires, and tig torches; PPE and workwear products consisting of smart bag child, welding gloves, proban coveralls, and jacket class whites; and medical equipment, such as flow meters, hose nipple and nut chrome products, and medical regulators. The company also exports its products to various countries in the Central and Eastern Africa Sub-Region. It serves mining, food and beverage, healthcare, chemicals, glass and minerals, manufacturing, energy, water and waste, construction, and paints and coatings industries. The company was formerly known as Tanzania Oxygen Limited. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

4978444.presentation: TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A. supplies and markets petroleum products in Ivory Coast. The company offers fuel, liquified petroleum gas, lubricant, and renewable energy though network of service stations. It also provides solar lamps. In addition, the company serves food, aviation, automotive, construction, chemicals, energy, metallurgy, steel, paper, wood, and textile industries. The company was formerly known as Total Cote d'Ivoire S.A. and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A. in June 2021. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. TotalEnergies Marketing Côte d'Ivoire S.A. operates as a subsidiary of TotalEnergies SE.

4976983.activite: Oil and Gas Refining and Marketing
4976983.presentation: TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC engages in the marketing and sale of petroleum and allied products in Ghana. The company offers lubricants; fuels, such as gasoil, petrol, and illuminating kerosene; and jet fuels and aviation gasolines. It provides solar solutions comprising solar powered service stations and phone charging solar kiosks; liquified petroleum gas and TotalEnergies Card solutions. It serves aviation, bitumen, and mining industries. The company was formerly known as Total Petroleum Ghana Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC in May 2022. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Accra, Ghana.

4916587.presentation: TotalEnergies Marketing Sénégal SA engages in the distribution of fuels in Senegal. It offers fuel, butane gas, jet fuel, heating oils, and solar lamps, as well as fuel cards. The company also sells car care products, lubricants, and car washing through their gas stations shops; and operates restaurants under the La Croissanterie and Tweat names. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Dakar, Senegal. TotalEnergies Marketing Sénégal SA is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies SE.

4914188.nom: Tractafric Motors Côte d'Ivoire S A
4914188.presentation: Tractafric Motors Côte d'Ivoire S A engages in vehicles distribution activities in Ivory Coast. It distributes a range of vehicles, including sedans, 4x4s, pick-ups, vans, trucks, buses, etc. of the Hyundai, Ford, Mazda, MCV, BMW, JAC, Mercedes-Benz trucks, and MINI brands; and aftermarket products, such as parts, oils, batteries, accessories, tires, etc., as well as car rental services. The company is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Tractafric Motors Côte d'Ivoire S A operates as a subsidiary of Tractafric Motors Corporation.

9857909.presentation: Trans Switch Africa Holdings Ltd, an investment holding Company, provides banking and finance related software. Trans Switch Africa Holdings Ltd was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Ebene, Mauritius.

4609438.presentation: Trust Bank Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides commercial banking products and services in the Gambia. It offers current, savings, and corporate and foreign currency accounts; and time/fixed deposits. The company also provides building loans/mortgage, car loan, personal loan, and overdraft; real time gross settlement; automated clearing house; trust alerts and exchange rates, as well as cheque discounting, banker’s indemnity, and bank guarantees; and ATM, online and mobile banking. In addition, it offers foreign currency purchase and sale, currency notes shipments, documentary letters of credit and collections, and SWIFT transfers. Further, the company is involved in the dealing of financial instruments of the money market in the Gambia; management of clients’ receivables and securities on clients’ accounts, including consulting services; banking information; and mortgage activities. Trust Bank Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Banjul, Gambia.

4863868.presentation: Turnstar Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property investment business across retail, commercial, residential, and industrial sectors in Botswana, Tanzania, and Dubai. It invests in retail, shopping centres, office, commercial, residential, and industrial properties. The company is based in Gaborone, Botswana.

4916877.presentation: Unilever Ghana PLC manufactures and markets fast-moving consumer goods in Ghana. It operates through Nutrition, Home Care, and Beauty & Personal Care segments. The company provides laundry and household care products; food products; and skin cleansing and care, oral, and deodorant products. The company is headquartered in Tema, Ghana. Unilever Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings Limited.

4976463.presentation: United Bus Service Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the bus fleet operation and property development businesses in Mauritius. It operates a fleet of 303 buses for public that services 61 routes. United Bus Service Limited was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4863694.presentation: United Docks Ltd, an investment holding company, operates as a real estate developer in the Republic of Mauritius. The company’s asset portfolio comprises land, commercial and residential properties, including business parks, office towers, serviced apartments, and warehousing facilities. The company also offers rental of shell and core office spaces, fully fitted and furnished offices, flexible co-working solutions under the Le Workspace brand, conferencing and event venues such as Les Suites by The Docks, and Park & Ride logistics services providing secure parking and shuttle connectivity in Port Louis. In addition, the company provides management consultancy; and management of investments. United Docks Ltd was founded in 1857 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius.

4998463.presentation: Universal Partners Limited operates as an investment holding company in the United Kingdom and Europe. The company provides workforce management solutions; provides recruitment services in the data, software, cloud infrastructure, and cyber security markets under the Xcede brand; and global energy recruitment services under the EarthStream brand. It also engages in the operation of a dental care platform and credit investing and lending activities. Additionally, the company engages in the development of toilets under the Propelair name. Universal Partners Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Grand Baie, Mauritius.

4913039.presentation: Uniwax SA manufactures and sells wax cloth in Ivory Coast. It offers wax block, wax print, sublime wax, custom fabrics, and signature under the Uniwax brand. Uniwax SA was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Yopougon, Ivory Coast.

100415787.presentation: Velogic Holding Company Limited provides supply chain solutions in Mauritius and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Cross-Border Logistics, Landside Logistics, and Packing & Shipping. It offers sea and air freight services, such as consolidation and deconsolidation, full container load, less than container load, project and general cargo, triangular trade shipment and/or transshipment, full documentation, garments on hanger, unaccompanied luggage, provision of dry, reefer and open-top container, and personal belonging, as well as perishables, temperature-controlled and hazardous goods. The company also provides brokerage services, such as customs clearance, permits processing, and application for import and/or export certificate, as well as express courier services through UPS. In addition, it offers storage and handling, cross-docking facilities, container freight station, reefer container storage and plugging, processing zones, as well as container services comprising container storage and handling, repair and maintenance, container modification and verification, sales and rental, and preparation of containers for food grade and garments on hangers. Further, the company offers packaging of sugars for international brands for export; transport of containers and bulk, in-house garage services, container handling for rodrigues; and ship chartering, bulk shipping, ship agency, survey and claims handling, maritime security crew transfer, stevedoring, and specialised logistics operations in association with grindrod services. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Port Louis, Mauritius. Velogic Holding Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of ER Group Limited.

4976778.activite: Oil and Gas Refining and Marketing
4976778.presentation: Vivo Energy Cote d'Ivoire SA markets and distributes fuels, lubricants, liquefied petroleum gas, and commercial services to mining, construction, power, road transport, aviation and marine sectors in Africa. It also provides card, food, convenience retail and other services. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Vivo Energy Cote d'Ivoire SA is a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell plc.

4976632.activite: Oil and Gas Refining and Marketing
4976632.presentation: Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited markets, supplies, and distributes fuels, lubricants, and Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) in Mauritius. It operates through Regulated and Non-regulated segments. The company offers fuelsave unleaded and fuelsave diesel; lubricants, including advanced motorcycle motor oil, longlife coolant, helix passenger car motor oil, rimula heavy-duty motor oil, and gadus; lubes, such as rimalax, spirax, and tellus; and solar/hybrid solutions. It also provides car wash services; shell and bank cards; retail food; and retail shops. It serves the aviation, marine, retail, and commercial business and business sectors under the Shell brand. The company was formerly known as Shell Mauritius Limited and changed its name to Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited in December 2011. Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Port Louis, Mauritius. Vivo Energy Mauritius Limited is a subsidiary of Vivo Energy Mauritius Holdings B.V.

6372119.presentation: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company operates as a telecommunication company in Tanzania. The company offers mobile; mobile internet and fixed data; SMS and social media applications; value-added services, such as RBT, Storybox, Chemba, Afyacall, Tusua Mapene, Spoti, VTV, Ting, Mdundo, esports and cloud gaming, Challenge Arena, Quizinc, TBC, PM Connect, Sandbox API, Amazon Prime, Netflix, and Disney; and customer care, including call centre, Vodacom shops, service desk, self-care products, customer alerts, and care and priority desks, as well as customer support through social media, and live chat on website and WhatsApp. It also provides deposits and withdrawals; person-to-person transfers; M-Pesa super-app; electronic payment solutions comprising virtual M-Pesa Visa card, merchants, consumer to business, business to consumer, and business to business; and financial services, such as M-Pesa overdraft, savings and loans, group savings, agent term loans, insurance services, wealth management, and business collection and disbursement accounts. In addition, the company offers mobility solutions, including voice, small medium enterprises packages, data, internet of things, reverse charge services, bulk messaging, SIM manager, and closed user group and ring back tone; inter-branch capacity, hosting/co-location, cloud solutions, session initiation protocol services, and digital solutions, as well as and internet services, such as remote area coverage via satellite connectivity. It serves customers through various sales and distribution channels, including wholesale distributors, retailers, franchise stores, direct sales partners, independent dealers and agents, street vendors, and informal resellers. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company is a subsidiary of Vodacom Group Limited.

4915079.presentation: Zambeef Products PLC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the agri-businesses in Zambia, Nigeria, and Ghana. It operates through Retailing and Food Production and Cropping and Milling segments. The company engages in the production, processing, distribution, and retailing of beef, chicken, pork, fish, milk, dairy, leather, eggs, edible oils, flour, day-old chick, and stockfeed products. It is also involved in the row cropping operations, such as maize, soya beans, and wheat, as well as flour mill and bread. In addition, the company operates transport and trucking fleets; and processes and sells leather, shoes, and poultry products, as well as chicken breeding. It operates distribution and retail outlets directly to end-consumers. The company serves its products through Zambeef Farming, Novatek, Zambeef, Zammilk, Zamhatch, Zamchick, Master Pork, Zamflour, Zamloaf, and Zamshu brand names. Zambeef Products PLC was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia.

4915078.presentation: Zambia Bata Shoe Company plc engages in the manufacture and sale of footwear products primarily in Zambia. It offers men’s, women’s, and children’s shoes, as well as back to school and sports shoes. The company was founded in 1937 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia.

7686127.nom: Zambia Forestry and Forest Industries Corporation Plc
7686127.presentation: Zambia Forestry and Forest Industries Corporation Plc establishes and manages pine and eucalyptus plantations in Zambia. It also operates a pole treatment plant; offers poles for fencing and construction of farms, animal ranches, chicken runs, residences, chalets, bridges, and other commercial structures, such as hotels, as well as for trusses to hold the roof of sheds and shelters; and utility poles used to support overhead power lines, including cable, fibre optic cable and related equipment, transformers, and street lights. Zambia Forestry and Forest Industries Corporation Plc was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ndola, Zambia.

4263811.presentation: Zambia National Commercial Bank Plc provides banking and financial services in Zambia. It operates through five segments: Retail Banking, Digital Banking, Corporate Banking, Business Banking, and Treasury Management. The Retail Banking segment offers private banking services, deposit and investment savings products, safe custody, debit cards, consumer loans, and mortgages. The Digital Banking segment provides internet banking, mobile banking, merchant services, and Zanaco Xpress. It offers various transactional services. The Corporate Banking segment offers corporate and investment banking solutions, which incorporate direct debit facilities, deposit products, overdrafts, loans and other credit facilities, and foreign currency solutions. The Business Banking segment provides specialist advice to start-ups and small and medium enterprises. The Treasury Management segment offers treasury transactions, such as investments in government securities, placements, open market operations, and other transactions related to dealing in foreign currencies. The company also offers trade solutions, electronic banking, merchant services, as well as personal and business insurance products, cash management solutions, vehicle asset financing, and solar financing solutions. The company serves personal, corporate, government, and agricultural sectors through multiple branches, agencies, automated teller machines, POS machines, and Zanaco Xpress agents. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia.

4813931.presentation: Zambia Reinsurance PLC provides reinsurance solutions in Zambia. It offers life reinsurance solutions covering mortality, critical illness, disability, and long-term care benefits; non-life reinsurance coverage, including property, casualty, marine, and specialty lines; and retrocession and reinsurance protection for reinsurers comprising capacity, risk transfer, and catastrophic coverage solutions. The company was formerly known as Prima Reinsurance Plc and changed its name to Zambia Reinsurance PLC in February 2021. Zambia Reinsurance PLC was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia.

4912272.presentation: Zambia Sugar Plc engages in growing of sugar cane in Zambia, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, South Africa, and Rest of Africa. The company operates in Cane Growing and Sugar Production segments. It offers household, brown, refined white, dark brown, icing, and castor sugars; treacle, maple, and golden syrup; and molasses. The company sells its products under the Whitespoon brand. It also exports its products. Zambia Sugar Plc was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Mazabuka, Zambia. Zambia Sugar Plc operates as a subsidiary of Illovo Sugar Limited.

4914989.presentation: Zambian Breweries Plc engages in the manufacture and distribution of alcoholic beverages in Zambia. The company offers beers under the Mosi Premium Lager, Mosi Light, Castle, Castle Lite, Carling Black Label, Eagle Lagers, Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona, Flying Fish, and Brutal Fruit. It distributes its products through retailers, bar owners, and wholesalers. Zambian Breweries Plc was founded in 1968 and is based in Lusaka, Zambia. Zambian Breweries Plc operates as a subsidiary of AB InBev Africa BV.
